title.zh: 卷453 列傳二百四十 荣全 喜昌 升泰 善庆 柏梁 恩泽 铭安 恭镗 庆裕 长庚 文海 凤全 增祺 贻穀 信勤
title.en: Volume 453 Biographies 240: Rong Quan, Xi Chang, Sheng Tai, Shan Qing, Bai Liang, En Ze, Ming An, Gong Tang, Qing Yu, Chang Geng, Wen Hai, Feng Quan, Zeng Qi, Yi Gu, Xin Qin
title.raw: 卷453 列傳二百四十 荣全 喜昌 升泰 善庆 柏梁 恩泽 铭安 恭镗 庆裕 长庚 文海 凤全 增祺 贻穀 信勤

sentences.zh: 列傳二百四十

translations.literal: Biographies, Number 240
translations.idiomatic: Biographies 240

sentences.zh: 榮全喜昌升泰善慶柏梁恩澤銘安恭鏜

translations.literal: Rong Quan, Xi Chang, Sheng Tai, Shan Qing, Bai Liang, En Ze, Ming An, Gong Tang
translations.idiomatic: Rong Quan, Xi Chang, Sheng Tai, Shan Qing, Bai Liang, En Ze, Ming An, Gong Tang

sentences.zh: 慶裕長庚文海鳳全增祺貽穀信勤

translations.literal: Qing Yu, Chang Geng, Wen Hai, Feng Quan, Zeng Qi, Yi Gu, Xin Qin
translations.idiomatic: Qing Yu, Chang Geng, Wen Hai, Feng Quan, Zeng Qi, Yi Gu, Xin Qin

sentences.zh: 榮全，關佳氏，滿洲正黃旗人，一等威勇侯那銘嗣子。

translations.literal: Rong Quan, of the Guanjia clan, a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner, was the heir of Naying, first-rank Marquis of Majestic Courage.
translations.idiomatic: Rong Quan, of the Guanjia clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner and heir to Naying, the first-rank Marquis of Majestic Courage.

sentences.zh: 咸豐元年，襲爵，授二等侍衛。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianfeng he inherited the title and was appointed a second-rank imperial bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Xianfeng reign he succeeded to the title and was appointed a second-rank imperial bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 從征山東，以功遷​​頭等，還直乾清門。

translations.literal: He campaigned in Shandong; for merit he was promoted to first rank and returned to duty at the Gate of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: On campaign in Shandong he earned promotion to first rank and was posted again to the Gate of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 十一年，出為塔爾巴哈台領隊大臣，歷喀喇沙爾辦事大臣、伊犁參贊大臣。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he went out as leading minister at Tarbagatai, and successively served as minister at Karashahr and as assistant military governor of Ili.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was sent out as leading minister at Tarbagatai, later serving as minister at Karashahr and as Ili's assistant military governor.

sentences.zh: 同治五年，以鑲紅旗蒙古副都統署伊犁將軍。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Tongzhi, as vice commander of the Mongol Bordered Red Banner he acted as military governor of Ili.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Tongzhi he served as acting military governor of Ili in his capacity as vice commander of the Mongol Bordered Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 明年，調烏里雅蘇台參贊大臣。

translations.literal: The next year he was transferred to be assistant military governor at Uliassutai.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was transferred to assistant military governor at Uliassutai.

sentences.zh: 時纏回襲陷伊犁，俄乘機遣兵入，藉口代為收復。

translations.literal: At that time the Dungan rebels seized Ili; Russia took the opportunity to send troops in, claiming to recover it on China's behalf.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Dungan rebels had seized Ili, and Russia seized the chance to march in, claiming to recover the region on China's behalf.

sentences.zh: 榮全內籌守禦，外示羈縻。

translations.literal: Rong Quan made preparations for defense within and showed restraint without.
translations.idiomatic: Within, Rong Quan prepared for defense; outwardly he showed restraint and conciliation.

sentences.zh: 又以索倫、蒙古被兵，民多亡入俄境，為請擇地安插，分部護之。

translations.literal: Because the Solon and Mongols had suffered warfare and many civilians had fled into Russian territory, he petitioned to choose lands for resettlement and post guards by division to protect them.
translations.idiomatic: As the Solon and Mongols had been ravaged by war and many people had fled into Russian territory, he petitioned to have lands chosen for their resettlement and guards posted in sections to protect them.

sentences.zh: 八年，朝旨以新疆各城多與俄接壤，命榮全會俄官，依三年勘辦西北界約記，建設烏屬界牌鄂博。

translations.literal: In the eighth year the court, noting that many cities in Xinjiang bordered Russia, ordered Rong Quan to meet Russian officials and, according to the records of the northwest boundary survey three years prior, erect boundary markers and cairns for the Uliassutai region.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, noting that many Xinjiang cities bordered Russia, the court ordered Rong Quan to meet with Russian officials and, following the northwest boundary survey records of three years before, set up boundary markers and cairns for the Uliassutai jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 先是，塔城和約兩國分界，自恰克圖西北逾烏梁海，首沙濱達巴哈，訖浩罕邊界，繪畫地圖，識以紅線。

translations.literal: Earlier, the Tacheng treaty had delimited the two states from Kyakhta northwest across the Uriankhai, from Shabindabaga in the northeast to the Kokand border, with maps drawn and marked in red lines.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, under the Tacheng treaty the two countries had been delimited from Kyakhta northwest across the Uriankhai, from Shabindabaga in the northeast to the Kokand frontier, with maps drawn and traced in red.

sentences.zh: 至是，集議烏克克卡倫仍依舊界，惟自東北沙濱達巴哈至西南賽留格木山柏郭蘇克壩補牌博八，明定界限，所謂烏里​​雅蘇台界約是也。

translations.literal: At this time the conference fixed Ukkekaren still on the old boundary; only from Shabindabaga in the northeast to Baoguosuke at Sailigemu Mountain in the southwest were eight boundary markers clearly defined—this is the so-called Uliassutai boundary treaty.
translations.idiomatic: At this conference Ukkekaren was left on the old boundary; only from Shabindabaga in the northeast to Baoguosuke on Sailigemu Mountain in the southwest were eight markers set to fix the line—this is what is called the Uliassutai boundary treaty.

sentences.zh: 九年，坐烏魯木齊城陷，褫職留任。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, because Ürümqi had fallen, he was stripped of office but retained on duty.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, because Ürümqi had fallen, he was dismissed from office but kept at his post.

sentences.zh: 十年，俄遣柯福滿將軍佔領庫爾札，聲收烏魯木齊，詔榮全赴伊犁收回城池。

translations.literal: In the tenth year Russia sent General Kaufman to occupy Kulja and announced the recovery of Ürümqi; the emperor ordered Rong Quan to proceed to Ili to recover the cities.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year Russia sent General Kaufman to occupy Kulja and proclaimed the recovery of Ürümqi; the court ordered Rong Quan to go to Ili and take back the cities.

sentences.zh: 榮全遂自烏城西進至霍博克賽里，直抵塔爾巴哈台。

translations.literal: Rong Quan then advanced west from the Uliassutai region to Khoboksar, reaching Tarbagatai directly.
translations.idiomatic: Rong Quan then marched west from Uliassutai to Khoboksar and on straight to Tarbagatai.

sentences.zh: 會天大雪，止舍。

translations.literal: Heavy snow fell; he halted and encamped.
translations.idiomatic: Heavy snow set in, and he halted to encamp.

sentences.zh: 逾歲，與俄官布呼策勒傅斯奇集議色爾賀鄂魯勒，榮全向之索還。

translations.literal: After more than a year he met with the Russian official Bukhtseretsky at Serkho Oorol; Rong Quan demanded its return.
translations.idiomatic: More than a year later he met the Russian official Bukhtseretsky at Serkho Oorol and demanded the territory be returned.

sentences.zh: 俄官陽言請命本國，而陰遣兵襲取瑪納斯，駸駸欲東犯。

translations.literal: The Russian official outwardly said he would request instructions from his country, but secretly sent troops to seize Manas and gradually prepared to invade eastward.
translations.idiomatic: The Russian official said openly that he would seek orders from his government, but secretly sent troops to seize Manas and steadily prepared to push east.

sentences.zh: 榮全不獲已，返塔城。

translations.literal: Rong Quan, having no alternative, returned to Tacheng.
translations.idiomatic: With no other choice, Rong Quan withdrew to Tacheng.

sentences.zh: 是時，俄人據伊犁可千餘人，滋驕橫，索倫、錫伯苦之。

translations.literal: At that time more than a thousand Russians occupied Ili and grew increasingly arrogant; the Solon and Xibe suffered under them.
translations.idiomatic: By then more than a thousand Russians held Ili and grew ever more overbearing; the Solon and Xibe peoples were ground down.

sentences.zh: 十二年，錫伯窘益甚，榮全濟以銀，俄官反出阻之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year the Xibe's distress grew worse; Rong Quan aided them with silver, but the Russian official came out to obstruct him.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year the Xibe were in still worse straits; Rong Quan sent them silver in relief, but the Russian official came out to block him.

sentences.zh: 榮全曰：「為我屬地，我自濟之。

translations.literal: Rong Quan said: "This is my territory—I shall aid them myself.
translations.idiomatic: Rong Quan said, "This is my territory—I will aid them myself.

sentences.zh: 與俄奚涉焉？

translations.literal: What has Russia to do with it?
translations.idiomatic: What business is that of Russia?

sentences.zh: 」牒駁之，俄官詞屈。

translations.literal: " He dispatched a rebuttal; the Russian official was reduced to silence.
translations.idiomatic: " He sent a formal rebuttal, and the Russian official had no answer.

sentences.zh: 上聞而嘉之。

translations.literal: The emperor heard of this and praised him.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor heard of this, he commended him.

sentences.zh: 會回構安集延擾動，上命榮全進攻瑪納斯綴寇勢，遂復其官。

translations.literal: When the Muslim rebel Yaqub Beg of Kokand stirred up trouble, the court ordered Rong Quan to attack Manas to check the rebels' momentum, and his office was restored.
translations.idiomatic: When the Kokand rebel Yaqub Beg stirred up unrest, the court ordered Rong Quan to attack Manas and blunt the rebels' advance, and his office was restored.

sentences.zh: 十三年，白彥虎犯上馬橋，榮全遣軍敗之沙子山。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year Bai Yanhu attacked Shangmaqiao; Rong Quan sent troops and defeated him at Shazishan.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year Bai Yanhu attacked Shangmaqiao; Rong Quan sent troops and defeated him at Shazishan.

sentences.zh: 光緒二年，師克瑪納斯南、北二城。

translations.literal: In the second year of Guangxu the army recovered the northern and southern cities of Manas.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Guangxu the army recovered both the northern and southern cities of Manas.

sentences.zh: 榮全數有功，尋召入京，歷兼護軍統領、右翼前鋒統領。

translations.literal: Rong Quan repeatedly distinguished himself and was soon summoned to the capital, where he served concurrently as commandant of the guards and commander of the vanguard of the Right Wing.
translations.idiomatic: Rong Quan won repeated distinction and was soon summoned to the capital, where he also served as commandant of the guards and commander of the Right Wing vanguard.

sentences.zh: 五年，卒，卹如製。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he died; funeral obsequies were granted according to regulation.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he died; funeral honors were granted according to statute.

sentences.zh: 喜昌，字桂亭，葛濟勒氏，滿洲鑲白旗人，世居吉林。

translations.literal: Xi Chang, styled Guiting, of the Gejile clan, a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner, for generations resided in Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Chang, styled Guiting, of the Gejile clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner whose family had long lived in Jilin.

sentences.zh: 亦以防俄著。

translations.literal: He too was noted for defending against Russia.
translations.idiomatic: He too was known for his defense against Russia.

sentences.zh: 初從軍徵捻，累功至協領。

translations.literal: He first joined the army to campaign against the Nian rebels and through accumulated merit rose to vice commandant.
translations.idiomatic: He first took the field against the Nian rebels and, through repeated merit, rose to vice commandant.

sentences.zh: 河內之役，以少勝眾，功尤盛，晉副都統。

translations.literal: In the campaign at Hanoi he defeated a larger force with fewer troops—a particularly outstanding achievement—and was promoted to vice commander.
translations.idiomatic: At Hanoi he defeated a larger force with fewer men—his finest achievement—and was promoted to vice commander.

sentences.zh: 西捻平，賜頭品秩，充西寧辦事大臣，光緒六年，調烏里雅蘇台參贊大臣。

translations.literal: After the western Nian were pacified, he was granted first-rank stipend and appointed minister at Xining; in the sixth year of Guangxu he was transferred to assistant military governor at Uliassutai.
translations.idiomatic: When the western Nian were pacified he was granted first-rank stipend and appointed minister at Xining; in the sixth year of Guangxu he was transferred to assistant military governor at Uliassutai.

sentences.zh: 時中俄有違言，俄軍窺吉林邊壤。

translations.literal: At that time China and Russia were at odds in words, and Russian troops watched the borderlands of Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Sino-Russian relations had soured, and Russian troops were eyeing the Jilin frontier.

sentences.zh: 朝命喜昌佐防務，因上言琿春為兵衝要地，宜練馬隊二千、步隊八千資守禦。

translations.literal: The court ordered Xi Chang to assist in defense; he therefore memorialized that Hunchun was a strategic military chokepoint and proposed training two thousand cavalry and eight thousand infantry for its defense.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Xi Chang to help with defense; he memorialized that Hunchun was a vital military choke point and proposed training two thousand cavalry and eight thousand infantry to hold it.

sentences.zh: 逾歲，抵琿春，相度地勢，乃專囑伊克唐阿防守事，而自率所部頓磨夷石，扼雙城、紅土岩來路，上韙之。

translations.literal: A year later he reached Hunchun, surveyed the terrain, entrusted the defense to Yi Ketang'a, and himself led his troops to encamp at Moyishi, blocking the routes from Shuangcheng and Hongtuyan—the emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: A year later he reached Hunchun, surveyed the ground, left defense to Yi Ketang'a, and himself led his troops to Moyishi to block the approaches from Shuangcheng and Hongtuyan—the emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 和議成，授庫倫辦事大臣，條上邊防六事，尋謝病歸。

translations.literal: After peace was made, he was appointed minister at Khüree and submitted six items on frontier defense, then soon resigned on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: After peace was concluded he was appointed minister at Khüree, submitted six proposals on frontier defense, and soon resigned on grounds of illness.

sentences.zh: 十七年，卒，予易州建祠。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he died; a temple was built for him at Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he died; a memorial temple was granted at Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 升泰，字竹珊，卓特氏，蒙古正黃旗人。

translations.literal: Sheng Tai, styled Zhushan, of the Zhuote clan, a Mongol of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Tai, styled Zhushan, of the Zhuote clan, was a Mongol of the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 入貲為員外郎，銓戶部。

translations.literal: He entered office by purchase as an outer court secretary and was assigned to the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He bought his way in as an outer court secretary and was assigned to the Board of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 出知山西汾州府，有政聲。

translations.literal: He went out as prefect of Fenzhou in Shanxi and gained a reputation for good administration.
translations.idiomatic: He served as prefect of Fenzhou in Shanxi and won a reputation for sound governance.

sentences.zh: 回寇擾境，錄守城功，晉道員，除河東道。

translations.literal: When Muslim rebels disturbed the border, he was recorded for merit in defending the city, promoted to circuit intendant, and appointed intendant of Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: When Muslim rebels raided the region he was credited for defending the city, promoted to circuit intendant, and appointed intendant of Hedong.

sentences.zh: 歷浙江按察使、雲南布政使。

translations.literal: He served successively as surveillance commissioner of Zhejiang and provincial administration commissioner of Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as surveillance commissioner of Zhejiang and provincial administration commissioner of Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 光緒七年，賞副都統銜，充伊犁參贊大臣，尋授內閣學士。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Guangxu he was granted the rank of vice commander and appointed assistant military governor of Ili, soon receiving appointment as a grand secretary of the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Guangxu he was granted vice-commander rank and appointed assistant military governor of Ili, soon becoming a grand secretary of the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 明年，署烏魯木齊都統，與俄羅斯定阿爾泰山邊界。

translations.literal: The next year he acted as military governor of Ürümqi and fixed the Altai mountain boundary with Russia.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he acted as military governor of Ürümqi and settled the Altai boundary with Russia.

sentences.zh: 俄人遇事齟《齒吾》，升泰執原議不稍讓。

translations.literal: Whenever matters arose the Russians quibbled; Sheng Tai held to the original agreement without yielding in the least.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever disputes arose the Russians quibbled, but Sheng Tai held to the original agreement without yielding an inch.

sentences.zh: 始受約束。

translations.literal: Only then did they submit to the constraints.
translations.idiomatic: Only then did they submit to the agreed limits.

sentences.zh: 十三年，改充駐藏幫辦大臣。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was reassigned as assistant minister stationed in Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was reassigned as assistant minister in Tibet.

sentences.zh: 時藏人築卡隆阿，為印度所敗。

translations.literal: At that time Tibetans had built fortifications at Longju and were defeated by India.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Tibetans had built fortifications at Longju and were defeated by the Indians.

sentences.zh: 上命辦事大臣文碩令藏人撤卡。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Minister Wen Shuo to have the Tibetans withdraw the forts.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered the resident minister Wen Shuo to have the Tibetans pull down the forts.

sentences.zh: 文碩謂為藏地，無可撤，嚴旨責焉，以升泰代之。

translations.literal: Wen Shuo said it was Tibetan territory and nothing could be withdrawn; after a stern edict rebuking him, Sheng Tai replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Shuo argued that it was Tibetan land and nothing could be withdrawn; after a stern rebuke from the throne, Sheng Tai replaced him.

sentences.zh: 而藏人誓復仇，頓兵​​帕克里，將痛擊印軍。

translations.literal: But the Tibetans swore revenge, massed troops at Phari, and prepared to strike the Indian army hard.
translations.idiomatic: The Tibetans, however, swore revenge, massed troops at Phari, and prepared to strike the Indian army hard.

sentences.zh: 升泰蒐集乾隆五十三年舊檔，哲孟雄受偪廓爾喀，達賴以日納宗給之，以雅拉、木支兩山為界，持示藏人。

translations.literal: Sheng Tai gathered archives from the fifty-third year of Qianlong: when Sikkim was menaced by Nepal, the Dalai Lama had given them Nainang, with Mount Yala and Mount Muzhi as the boundary, and showed this to the Tibetans.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Tai gathered records from the fifty-third year of Qianlong: when Sikkim was pressed by Nepal, the Dalai Lama had granted them Nainang, with Mount Yala and Mount Muzhi as the boundary, and he showed this to the Tibetans.

sentences.zh: 藏人曰：「地雖予哲，今哲通英，宜收回。

translations.literal: The Tibetans said: "Although we gave the land to Sikkim, now Sikkim is on good terms with Britain—we should take it back.
translations.idiomatic: The Tibetans said, "Although we gave that land to Sikkim, Sikkim is now on good terms with Britain—we ought to take it back.

sentences.zh: 」升泰數止之，不從。

translations.literal: " Sheng Tai repeatedly tried to stop them; they would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: " Sheng Tai tried again and again to stop them, but they would not listen.

sentences.zh: 英使願媾和，朝旨令升泰赴邊界與印官議約。

translations.literal: The British minister wished to make peace; the court ordered Sheng Tai to go to the border to negotiate a treaty with Indian officials.
translations.idiomatic: The British minister sought peace, and the court ordered Sheng Tai to the frontier to negotiate a treaty with Indian officials.

sentences.zh: 十四年，印軍收哲全境。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year the Indian army took all of Sikkim.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year the Indian army occupied all of Sikkim.

sentences.zh: 藏兵又敗咱利，亞東、朗熱並失。

translations.literal: Tibetan troops were again defeated at Taring, and Yadong and Langre were also lost.
translations.idiomatic: Tibetan troops were defeated again at Taring, and Yadong and Langre were lost as well.

sentences.zh: 隙愈深，群思報復，升泰數嚴止之，仍不從。

translations.literal: The rift grew deeper; all thought of revenge; Sheng Tai repeatedly forbade it sternly, but they still would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: The rift deepened; everyone thought of revenge; Sheng Tai sternly forbade it again and again, yet they still would not listen.

sentences.zh: 會天寒，印官趣升泰赴議，而藏人請代索哲孟雄、布魯克巴侵地，否則傾眾一戰。

translations.literal: As the weather turned cold, Indian officials urged Sheng Tai to come negotiate, while Tibetans asked him to recover the invaded lands of Sikkim and Bhutan for them, or else they would throw all their forces into battle.
translations.idiomatic: When cold weather set in, Indian officials pressed Sheng Tai to negotiate, while Tibetans asked him to recover Sikkim and Bhutan's invaded lands on their behalf—or else they would throw their whole force into battle.

sentences.zh: 升泰仍百計諭藏僧，戒藏番毋妄動。

translations.literal: Sheng Tai still used every means to instruct the Tibetan monks and warn the Tibetan tribes not to act rashly.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Tai still used every means to counsel the Tibetan monks and warn the Tibetan tribes not to act rashly.

sentences.zh: 及至邊，布部長遣兵千七百人護衛。

translations.literal: When he reached the border, the Bhutanese chief sent seventeen hundred troops as escort.
translations.idiomatic: When he reached the frontier, the Bhutanese chief sent seventeen hundred men as an escort.

sentences.zh: 升泰慮為英口實，謝去，並乞印綬封典，升泰允代請諸朝。

translations.literal: Sheng Tai feared this would give Britain a pretext and declined; the chief also asked for imperial seals and titles, and Sheng Tai agreed to petition the court on his behalf.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Tai feared this would give the British a pretext and declined; the chief also asked for imperial seals and enfeoffment, and Sheng Tai agreed to petition the court on his behalf.

sentences.zh: 既與英政務司保爾會於納盪，索藏償兵費。

translations.literal: He then met with the British political officer Paul at Nathang; they demanded that Tibet pay war costs.
translations.idiomatic: He then met the British political officer Paul at Nathang, who demanded that Tibet pay war costs.

sentences.zh: 升泰曰：「哲為藏屬，索費無名。

translations.literal: Sheng Tai said: "Sikkim belongs to Tibet; demanding payment has no basis.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Tai said, "Sikkim belongs to Tibet; there is no grounds for such a demand.

sentences.zh: 」英人又在布境及後藏幹壩修路，藏人益大震。

translations.literal: " The British also built roads in Bhutan and at Gangba in rear Tibet; the Tibetans were all the more alarmed.
translations.idiomatic: " The British were also building roads in Bhutan and at Gangba in rear Tibet, and the Tibetans were more alarmed than ever.

sentences.zh: 英官要求甚奢，升泰力折之，藏人漸就範。

translations.literal: British officials made very extravagant demands; Sheng Tai forcefully beat them down, and the Tibetans gradually submitted to discipline.
translations.idiomatic: British demands were extravagant; Sheng Tai forcefully beat them back, and the Tibetans gradually fell into line.

sentences.zh: 升泰數要英撤兵，英不可。

translations.literal: Sheng Tai repeatedly demanded that Britain withdraw its troops; Britain would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Tai repeatedly demanded British withdrawal, but Britain refused.

sentences.zh: 升泰以大雪封山，運糧無所，退駐仁進岡。

translations.literal: Because heavy snow blocked the mountains and grain could not be transported, Sheng Tai withdrew to encamp at Rinchengang.
translations.idiomatic: Heavy snow sealed the passes and grain could not be moved, so Sheng Tai withdrew to Rinchengang.

sentences.zh: 英人既掠哲地，复羈其部長土尕朗思，置之噶倫繃，招印度、廓爾喀遊民墾荒。

translations.literal: After the British had seized Sikkim's territory, they also detained its chief Tugulansi, placed him at Galingang, and recruited Indian and Nepalese migrants to open wasteland.
translations.idiomatic: After seizing Sikkim's territory, the British detained its chief Tugulansi, held him at Galingang, and brought in Indian and Nepalese settlers to open the land.

sentences.zh: 廷議以哲事無從挽救，慮梗藏議，諭升泰勿問。

translations.literal: Court deliberation held that the Sikkim affair could not be salvaged and feared it would obstruct Tibetan negotiations; Sheng Tai was instructed not to inquire further.
translations.idiomatic: The court decided the Sikkim affair could not be salvaged and feared it would obstruct Tibetan negotiations, and instructed Sheng Tai not to pursue it further.

sentences.zh: 藏、哲舊界，本在雅拉、支木。

translations.literal: The old boundary between Tibet and Sikkim had originally lain at Yala and Zhimu.
translations.idiomatic: The old Tibet-Sikkim boundary had originally run along Yala and Zhimu.

sentences.zh: 後商人往​​來咱利，為新闢捷徑。

translations.literal: Later merchants traveled back and forth by Taring, which became a newly opened shortcut.
translations.idiomatic: Later merchants began using Taring as a newly opened shortcut.

sentences.zh: 升泰議以咱利山分藏、哲界，以符前案。

translations.literal: Sheng Tai proposed using Mount Taring to divide the Tibet-Sikkim boundary, in accord with the earlier case.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Tai proposed dividing Tibet and Sikkim at Mount Taring, in keeping with the earlier precedent.

sentences.zh: 其印、哲界在日喜曲河，擬約中註明。

translations.literal: The India-Sikkim boundary lay at the Rixiqu River; this was to be noted in the draft treaty.
translations.idiomatic: The India-Sikkim boundary at the Rixiqu River was to be specified in the treaty draft.

sentences.zh: 哲部長母挈兩孫赴升泰營泣訴，丐中朝作主，升泰無如何。

translations.literal: The Sikkimese chief's mother came to Sheng Tai's camp with two grandsons, weeping and begging the central court to act as arbiter; Sheng Tai could do nothing.
translations.idiomatic: The Sikkimese chief's mother came to Sheng Tai's camp with two grandsons, weeping and begging the central court to intervene; Sheng Tai could do nothing.

sentences.zh: 英人又欲易置其部長，升泰力阻之。

translations.literal: The British also wished to replace their chief; Sheng Tai forcefully blocked this.
translations.idiomatic: The British also wanted to replace the Sikkimese chief; Sheng Tai blocked it firmly.

sentences.zh: 土尕朗思謂願棄此居春丕，升泰弗許，慮英責言也。

translations.literal: Tugulansi said he was willing to abandon this place and live at Chumbi; Sheng Tai would not permit it, fearing British reproach.
translations.idiomatic: Tugulansi said he would abandon his seat and live at Chumbi; Sheng Tai refused, fearing British complaint.

sentences.zh: 十五年春，藏兵撤退。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fifteenth year the Tibetan troops withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fifteenth year the Tibetan troops withdrew.

sentences.zh: 升泰請總署達英使，電印軍速撤。

translations.literal: Sheng Tai asked the Zongli Yamen to reach the British minister and telegraph the Indian army to withdraw quickly.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Tai asked the Zongli Yamen to contact the British minister and telegraph the Indian army to withdraw at once.

sentences.zh: 逮既撤，而英人猶久不訂約。

translations.literal: After they had withdrawn, the British still long delayed concluding a treaty.
translations.idiomatic: Even after withdrawal, the British still delayed concluding a treaty for a long time.

sentences.zh: 升泰上疏略謂：「聞藏人言：'與有仇之英議和，不若與無仇之俄通好。

translations.literal: Sheng Tai memorialized in summary: "I have heard Tibetans say: 'To make peace with Britain, our enemy, is not as good as opening friendly relations with Russia, who bears us no grudge.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Tai memorialized in summary: "I have heard Tibetans say, 'To make peace with hostile Britain is not as good as befriending Russia, who bears us no grudge.

sentences.zh: '設藏番果與通款，英、俄必互相猜忌，後患方長。

translations.literal: ' If the Tibetan tribes truly opened relations, Britain and Russia would surely grow mutually suspicious, and future troubles would only lengthen.
translations.idiomatic: ' If the Tibetans truly opened relations with Russia, Britain and Russia would grow mutually suspicious, and future troubles would only grow.

sentences.zh: 乞告英使，電趣印督速定藏約。

translations.literal: I beg that the British minister be told to telegraph the Indian governor to conclude the Tibetan treaty quickly.
translations.idiomatic: I beg that the British minister be told to telegraph the Indian governor to conclude the Tibetan treaty quickly.

sentences.zh: 」又言：「與英初次會議，英人欲至藏貿易。

translations.literal: " He also said: "At the first conference with Britain, the British wished to trade in Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: " He also wrote: "At the first conference with Britain, the British wanted to trade in Tibet itself.

sentences.zh: 告以番情疑詐，始許退至江孜。

translations.literal: I told them the tribes were suspicious and deceitful; only then did they agree to withdraw to Gyantse.
translations.idiomatic: I told them the tribes were suspicious and hard to trust; only then did they agree to withdraw to Gyantse.

sentences.zh: 力言再四，又許退至帕隘。

translations.literal: After speaking forcefully again and again, they again agreed to withdraw to Phari.
translations.idiomatic: After I pressed the point again and again, they agreed to withdraw further to Phari.

sentences.zh: 臣力諭藏番，通商萬不能免，始出結遵辦。

translations.literal: Your servant strongly instructed the Tibetan tribes that trade could by no means be avoided; only then did they issue a bond pledging compliance.
translations.idiomatic: I strongly told the Tibetan tribes that trade could not be avoided; only then did they issue a bond pledging compliance.

sentences.zh: 今英慮他國援以為請，忽議中止。

translations.literal: Now Britain, fearing other countries would use this as a basis to make demands, suddenly proposed to break off talks.
translations.idiomatic: Now Britain, fearing other powers would use this as a precedent to demand the same, suddenly proposed to break off talks.

sentences.zh: 在藏人固所深願，在俄人亦不能有所干求。

translations.literal: This is deeply wished by Tibetans and also means Russians cannot make any demands.
translations.idiomatic: This is deeply wished by the Tibetans, and the Russians likewise cannot press any demands.

sentences.zh: 惟日后防範宜嚴，未可再涉疏懈。

translations.literal: Only hereafter defense must be strict; we cannot again lapse into negligence.
translations.idiomatic: Only hereafter defense must be strict; we cannot lapse into negligence again.

sentences.zh: 入夏至今，曠日持久，請敕總署牒英使速議結。

translations.literal: From summer until now the delay has been prolonged; I beg that the Zongli Yamen be ordered to memorialize the British minister to conclude talks quickly.
translations.idiomatic: From summer until now the delay has dragged on; I beg that the Zongli Yamen be ordered to press the British minister to conclude quickly.

sentences.zh: 十六年，以升泰為全權大臣，與印督定約八款，自布坦交界支莫摯山起，至廓爾喀邊界止，分藏、哲界，哲境歸英保護，所謂藏印條款是也，語詳邦交志。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year Sheng Tai was made plenipotentiary and with the Indian governor concluded an eight-article treaty from Zhimozhi Mountain at the Bhutan border to the Nepal border, dividing Tibet and Sikkim; Sikkim was placed under British protection—this is the so-called Tibet-India convention; details are in the Treaties section.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year Sheng Tai was made plenipotentiary and with the Indian governor concluded an eight-article treaty from Zhimozhi Mountain on the Bhutan border to the Nepal frontier, dividing Tibet and Sikkim and placing Sikkim under British protection—this is the so-called Tibet-India Convention; details are given in the Treaties section.

sentences.zh: 十八年，卒於仁進岡。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he died at Rinchengang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he died at Rinchengang.

sentences.zh: 事聞，優詔賜卹。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, an excellent edict granted funeral obsequies.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached the throne, an edict granted him exceptional funeral honors.

sentences.zh: 善慶，張佳氏，滿洲正黃旗人，黑龍江駐防。

translations.literal: Shan Qing, of the Zhangjia clan, a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner, garrisoned at Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Shan Qing, of the Zhangjia clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner stationed at Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 初從勝保徵捻，積勳至協領，賜號濟特固勒忒依巴圖魯。

translations.literal: He first followed Sengge Rinchen to campaign against the Nian rebels, accumulated merit to vice commandant, and was granted the title Jiteguletei Batulu.
translations.idiomatic: He first campaigned against the Nian under Sengge Rinchen, rose through merit to vice commandant, and was granted the title Jiteguletei Batulu.

sentences.zh: 克鳳陽，擢副都統。

translations.literal: He captured Fengyang and was promoted to vice commander.
translations.idiomatic: He took Fengyang and was promoted to vice commander.

sentences.zh: 論复定遠功，晉頭品服。

translations.literal: For merit in recovering Dingyuan he was advanced to first-rank stipend.
translations.idiomatic: For merit in recovering Dingyuan he was advanced to first-rank stipend.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，追捻至靈壁，平宿州寇墟。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he pursued the Nian to Lingbi and pacified the rebel ruins at Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi he pursued the Nian to Lingbi and pacified the rebel stronghold at Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 創發，乞病去。

translations.literal: An old wound broke out; he begged leave on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: An old wound reopened and he resigned on grounds of illness.

sentences.zh: 逾歲，朝旨以捻事棘，命選吉林、黑龍江騎旅赴皖。

translations.literal: After more than a year the court, finding the Nian situation critical, ordered cavalry from Jilin and Heilongjiang selected and sent to Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: More than a year later, with the Nian crisis acute, the court ordered cavalry from Jilin and Heilongjiang sent to Anhui.

sentences.zh: 軍抵河南，張之萬疏留，連敗粵寇於南陽及湖北陽邳灘鮮花鎮。

translations.literal: When the army reached Henan, Zhang Zhiwan memorialized to retain them; they repeatedly defeated Cantonese rebels at Nanyang and at Yangpitan and Xianhuazhen in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: When the army reached Henan, Zhang Zhiwan memorialized to keep them; they repeatedly defeated Cantonese rebels at Nanyang and at Yangpitan and Xianhuazhen in Hubei.

sentences.zh: 坐所部兵馬疲瘠褫職，仍留軍。

translations.literal: Because his troops and horses were worn and lean he was stripped of office, but remained with the army.
translations.idiomatic: Because his troops and horses were exhausted he was dismissed from office but kept with the army.

sentences.zh: 四年，授吉林雙城堡總管。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was appointed commandant of Shuangcheng Fort in Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was appointed commandant of Shuangcheng Fort in Jilin.

sentences.zh: 以戰功復故官，即於軍前除杭州副都統。

translations.literal: For battle merit his former office was restored, and he was immediately appointed vice commander of Hangzhou at the front.
translations.idiomatic: For battle merit his former rank was restored and he was appointed vice commander of Hangzhou at the front.

sentences.zh: 再坐營馬侵踏民田褫職，追擊竄賊大同集，被宥。

translations.literal: Again, because camp horses trampled civilian fields he was stripped of office; pursuing fleeing rebels at Datongji he was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Again, because camp horses trampled civilian fields he was dismissed; pursuing fleeing rebels at Datongji he was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 六年，與劉銘傳剿東捻，敗之濰縣松樹山。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, with Liu Mingchuan he suppressed the eastern Nian and defeated them at Songshushan in Weixian.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, with Liu Mingchuan he fought the eastern Nian and defeated them at Songshushan in Weixian.

sentences.zh: 捻奔贛榆，追及之。

translations.literal: The Nian fled toward Ganyu; he overtook them.
translations.idiomatic: The Nian fled toward Ganyu and he overtook them.

sentences.zh: 銘傳自當賴文光，而令善慶當任柱。

translations.literal: Mingchuan himself faced Lai Wenguang, while ordering Shan Qing to face Ren Zhu.
translations.idiomatic: Mingchuan himself took on Lai Wenguang and ordered Shan Qing to face Ren Zhu.

sentences.zh: 任柱殊死鬥，善慶令騎旅下馬結陣疾擊之，屍山積，猶進不止。

translations.literal: Ren Zhu fought desperately; Shan Qing ordered the cavalry to dismount, form ranks, and strike hard; corpses piled like hills, yet the enemy still pressed on.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Zhu fought desperately; Shan Qing ordered his cavalry to dismount, form ranks, and strike hard—corpses piled like hills, yet the enemy still pressed forward.

sentences.zh: 會大霧，窈冥不見人。

translations.literal: Heavy fog fell; in the gloom one could see no one.
translations.idiomatic: A heavy fog fell, and in the gloom nothing could be seen.

sentences.zh: 銘傳分軍襲其後，善慶率隊大呼衝殺，槍砲雨坌，降人潘貴升斬任酋於陣。

translations.literal: Mingchuan divided his forces to strike from the rear; Shan Qing led his men shouting in a charge; guns and cannon rained down; the defector Pan Guisheng slew the rebel chief Ren in the field.
translations.idiomatic: Mingchuan sent troops to strike from the rear while Shan Qing led a shouting charge; guns and cannon poured in, and the defector Pan Guisheng slew the rebel chief Ren in the field.

sentences.zh: 善慶乘勢追擊，斬馘千餘級。

translations.literal: Shan Qing pressed the pursuit and took more than a thousand heads.
translations.idiomatic: Shan Qing pressed the pursuit and took more than a thousand heads.

sentences.zh: 論功，賞黃馬褂。

translations.literal: For merit he was rewarded with a yellow riding jacket.
translations.idiomatic: For merit he was rewarded with a yellow riding jacket.

sentences.zh: 賴酋勢益蹙，阻瀰河弗能達，乃據壽光王胡城。

translations.literal: The rebel chief Lai's position grew tighter; blocked by the Mi River he could not advance, and so occupied Wanghucheng in Shouguang.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel chief Lai was increasingly cornered; blocked by the Mi River he could not advance and held Wanghucheng in Shouguang.

sentences.zh: 銘傳等分左右進，善慶與溫德勒克西拒之。

translations.literal: Mingchuan and others advanced on left and right; Shan Qing and Wendelekexi blocked them.
translations.idiomatic: Mingchuan and others advanced on both flanks; Shan Qing and Wendelekexi held them off.

sentences.zh: 追至鳳凰台，為他將所敗，就縛於揚州，予騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: Pursuing to Fenghuangtai, Lai was defeated by another general and bound at Yangzhou; Shan Qing was granted a hereditary captaincy.
translations.idiomatic: Pursued to Fenghuangtai, Lai was defeated by another general and captured at Yangzhou; Shan Qing was granted a hereditary captaincy.

sentences.zh: 七年，西捻平，張總愚自沉於河，餘匪為善慶等所殲，晉二等輕車都尉，赴本官。

translations.literal: In the seventh year the western Nian were pacified; Zhang Zongyu drowned himself in a river; the remaining bandits were destroyed by Shan Qing and others; he was promoted to second-rank commandant of light chariots and returned to his post.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year the western Nian were pacified; Zhang Zongyu drowned himself; the remaining bandits were wiped out by Shan Qing and others; he was promoted to second-rank commandant of light chariots and returned to his post.

sentences.zh: 擢杭州將軍。

translations.literal: He was promoted to military governor of Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to military governor of Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 杭州駐防自克復後，昆壽規复營製，連成重建營牆。

translations.literal: After Hangzhou garrison was recovered, Kunshou planned to restore camp regulations and Liancheng rebuilt the camp walls.
translations.idiomatic: After the Hangzhou garrison was recovered, Kunshou planned to restore camp regulations and Liancheng rebuilt the camp walls.

sentences.zh: 善慶至，籌設漸備。

translations.literal: When Shan Qing arrived, arrangements were gradually completed.
translations.idiomatic: When Shan Qing arrived, arrangements were gradually brought to completion.

sentences.zh: 光緒改元，調綏遠城，歷寧夏、江寧。

translations.literal: At the change of reign to Guangxu he was transferred to Suiyuancheng, and successively served at Ningxia and Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Guangxu reign he was transferred to Suiyuancheng and later served at Ningxia and Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 召還，授正紅旗漢軍副都統，駐師通州。

translations.literal: Summoned back, he was appointed vice commander of the Chinese Plain Red Banner and stationed his troops at Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned back, he was appointed vice commander of the Chinese Plain Red Banner and stationed his troops at Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一年，充御前侍衛，佐海軍事務。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he served as an imperial bodyguard and assisted in naval affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he served as an imperial bodyguard and assisted in naval affairs.

sentences.zh: 十三年，出為福州將軍。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he went out as military governor of Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was appointed military governor of Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 次年，卒，予建祠，諡勤敏。

translations.literal: The next year he died; a temple was granted, posthumous name Qinmin.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he died; a memorial temple was granted, with the posthumous name Qinmin.

sentences.zh: 柏梁，字研香，瓜爾佳氏，滿洲正白旗人，杭州駐防。

translations.literal: Bai Liang, styled Yanxiang, of the Guwalgiya clan, a Manchu of the Plain White Banner, garrisoned at Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Liang, styled Yanxiang, of the Guwalgiya clan, was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner stationed at Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 父麟瑞，咸豐末陣亡乍浦，見忠義傳。

translations.literal: His father Linrui died in battle at Zhapu in the late Xianfeng period; see the Loyal and Righteous biographies.
translations.idiomatic: His father Linrui fell in battle at Zhapu in the late Xianfeng years; see the Loyal and Righteous biographies.

sentences.zh: 柏梁少從其叔父鳳瑞出，隸李鴻章軍，轉戰江、浙。

translations.literal: Bai Liang in youth followed his uncle Fengrui out, joined Li Hongzhang's army, and campaigned back and forth in Jiangsu and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In youth Bai Liang followed his uncle Fengrui into the field, joined Li Hongzhang's army, and fought across Jiangsu and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 攻太倉州，柏樑自南門先登。

translations.literal: Attacking Taicang prefecture, Bai Liang was first to scale the south gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the assault on Taicang he was first over the south gate.

sentences.zh: 復攻蘇州，戰於黃天蕩，陣斬悍目。

translations.literal: Attacking Suzhou again, he fought at Huangtiandang and slew a fierce enemy officer in the field.
translations.idiomatic: In the renewed assault on Suzhou he fought at Huangtiandang and slew a fierce enemy officer in the field.

sentences.zh: 攻嘉興、宜興、江陰、金壇，柏梁皆有功。

translations.literal: In attacks on Jiaxing, Yixing, Jiangyin, and Jintan, Bai Liang distinguished himself each time.
translations.idiomatic: In the attacks on Jiaxing, Yixing, Jiangyin, and Jintan he distinguished himself each time.

sentences.zh: 改隸勝保軍，戰江北，屢捷，累保至協領，賞花翎。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Sengge Rinchen's army, fought north of the Yangzi with repeated victories, and through cumulative recommendations rose to vice commandant and was rewarded with a peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to Sengge Rinchen's army, he fought north of the Yangzi with repeated victories, rose to vice commandant, and was rewarded with a peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 杭州克復，調歸駐防，補協領。

translations.literal: When Hangzhou was recovered he was transferred back to the garrison and appointed vice commandant.
translations.idiomatic: When Hangzhou was recovered he returned to the garrison and was appointed vice commandant.

sentences.zh: 承歷任將軍辦理營務，善慶尤倚任之。

translations.literal: He continued the successive military governors in managing camp affairs; Shan Qing especially relied on him.
translations.idiomatic: He continued the work of successive governors in camp affairs, and Shan Qing relied on him especially.

sentences.zh: 光緒中，駐防初設洋槍隊，以柏梁充全營翼長，兼掌兵司。

translations.literal: In the Guangxu period the garrison first established a foreign-rifle corps; Bai Liang was made wing commander of the whole camp and also directed the military office.
translations.idiomatic: In the Guangxu period the garrison first formed a foreign-rifle corps; Bai Liang served as wing commander of the whole camp and also directed the military office.

sentences.zh: 規畫營製，均照新軍式訓練，紀律肅然。

translations.literal: He planned camp regulations and trained all according to the new-army model; discipline was strict.
translations.idiomatic: He planned camp regulations and trained all on the new-army model; discipline was strict.

sentences.zh: 敘勞，以副都統記名。

translations.literal: For recorded merit he was placed on the list for vice commander.
translations.idiomatic: For recorded merit he was placed on the list for vice commander.

sentences.zh: 入覲，奏對稱旨。

translations.literal: On audience at court his memorial responses pleased the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: At court audience his responses pleased the emperor.

sentences.zh: 以曉暢戎機、訓練出力，賞頭品服。

translations.literal: Because he understood military affairs and exerted himself in training, he was rewarded with first-rank stipend.
translations.idiomatic: For his grasp of military affairs and exertion in training he was rewarded with first-rank stipend.

sentences.zh: 駐防舊有旗倉，久為兵燹，柏梁請撥款重建。

translations.literal: The garrison's old banner granaries had long been ruined by warfare; Bai Liang petitioned for funds to rebuild them.
translations.idiomatic: The garrison's old banner granaries had long been ruined by war; Bai Liang petitioned for funds to rebuild them.

sentences.zh: 旋授乍浦副都統。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed vice commander of Zhapu.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was appointed vice commander of Zhapu.

sentences.zh: 乍浦駐防營毀於粵亂，副都統駐杭州。

translations.literal: The Zhapu garrison camp had been destroyed in the Cantonese rebellion; the vice commander resided at Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhapu garrison camp had been destroyed in the Taiping rebellion; the vice commander resided at Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 柏梁蒞任，歲至乍浦巡視海防。

translations.literal: When Bai Liang took office he went each year to Zhapu to inspect coastal defense.
translations.idiomatic: On taking office Bai Liang went each year to Zhapu to inspect coastal defense.

sentences.zh: 以勞卒。

translations.literal: He died from overwork.
translations.idiomatic: He died from overwork.

sentences.zh: 賜卹如製。

translations.literal: Funeral obsequies were granted according to regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Funeral honors were granted according to statute.

sentences.zh: 恩澤，字雨三，噶奇特氏，蒙古鑲藍旗人，荊州駐防。

translations.literal: En Ze, styled Yusan, of the Gaqite clan, a Mongol of the Bordered Blue Banner, garrisoned at Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: En Ze, styled Yusan, of the Gaqite clan, was a Mongol of the Bordered Blue Banner stationed at Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 光緒初，以佐領從金順出關，克黃田，复烏魯木齊諸城，擢協領。

translations.literal: Early in Guangxu, as company commander he followed Jin Shun beyond the pass, captured Huangtian, recovered the cities of Ürümqi, and was promoted to vice commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Guangxu, as company commander he followed Jin Shun beyond the pass, took Huangtian, recovered Ürümqi and other cities, and was promoted to vice commandant.

sentences.zh: 其秋，回寇奔呼圖壁，追擊之，大潰，又扼之頭屯河，白彥虎益窘。

translations.literal: That autumn Muslim rebels fled toward Hutubi; he pursued and routed them, then blocked them at Toutun River; Bai Yanhu grew still more desperate.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn Muslim rebels fled toward Hutubi; he pursued and routed them, then blocked them at the Toutun River, and Bai Yanhu grew still more desperate.

sentences.zh: 進攻瑪納斯，轟潰城垣數丈，恩澤先登，諸軍繼之，城拔，晉副都統。

translations.literal: Attacking Manas, cannon breached several zhang of wall; En Ze was first to scale; the armies followed; the city fell; he was promoted to vice commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the assault on Manas, cannon breached several zhang of wall; En Ze was first over the top, the armies followed, and the city fell; he was promoted to vice commander.

sentences.zh: 歷權巴里坤、烏魯木齊領隊大臣。

translations.literal: He successively acted as leading minister at Barkul and Ürümqi.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as acting leading minister at Barkul and Ürümqi.

sentences.zh: 以劉錦棠薦。

translations.literal: On Liu Jintang's recommendation.
translations.idiomatic: On Liu Jintang's recommendation.

sentences.zh: 除吉林副都統，移琿春。

translations.literal: He was appointed vice commander of Jilin and transferred to Hunchun.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed vice commander of Jilin and transferred to Hunchun.

sentences.zh: 二十年，日本敗盟，與將軍長順籌戰守。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year Japan broke the treaty; with Military Governor Changshun he planned for war and defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year Japan broke the treaty; with Military Governor Changshun he planned for war and defense.

sentences.zh: 乃治團練，築台壘，設疑兵，敵知有備，引兵去。

translations.literal: He then organized militia, built forts and platforms, and set out decoy troops; the enemy, knowing preparations were made, withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: He organized militia, built forts, and set decoys; seeing preparations, the enemy withdrew.

sentences.zh: 尋署將軍。

translations.literal: Soon he acted as military governor.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he acted as military governor.

sentences.zh: 其時東山馬賊猖獗，伯都訥、烏拉教匪乘機竊發，竄擾官街、白旗屯。

translations.literal: At that time bandits were rampant in the eastern hills; rebels at Boduna and Wula seized the chance to rise and raided Guanjie and Baiqitun.
translations.idiomatic: At that time bandits were rampant in the eastern hills; rebels at Boduna and Wula seized the chance to rise and raided Guanjie and Baiqitun.

sentences.zh: 恩澤聞警，率師分擊之，夷其堅堡。

translations.literal: Hearing the alarm, En Ze led troops in divided attacks and destroyed their strong forts.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing the alarm, En Ze led troops in divided attacks and destroyed their strong forts.

sentences.zh: 又遣提督雲春等，搜東山逸匪。

translations.literal: He also sent Regional Commander Yunchun and others to search out fleeing bandits in the eastern hills.
translations.idiomatic: He also sent Regional Commander Yunchun and others to hunt down fleeing bandits in the eastern hills.

sentences.zh: 明年，調黑龍江，督邊防。

translations.literal: The next year he was transferred to Heilongjiang to supervise frontier defense.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was transferred to Heilongjiang to supervise frontier defense.

sentences.zh: 先後疏請改練洋操，招墾荒地，賑恤窮乏。

translations.literal: He successively memorialized to drill in foreign-style exercises, recruit settlers for wasteland, and relieve the destitute.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized repeatedly to drill in Western-style exercises, recruit settlers for wasteland, and relieve the destitute.

sentences.zh: 俄而鬍匪據觀音山南北圍，謀劫金廠。

translations.literal: Soon bandits occupied the north and south passes of Guanyin Mountain and plotted to rob the gold mines.
translations.idiomatic: Soon bandits held the north and south passes of Guanyin Mountain and plotted to rob the gold mines.

sentences.zh: 恩澤诇知之，嚴備以待。

translations.literal: En Ze learned of this through reconnaissance and made strict preparations.
translations.idiomatic: En Ze learned of this through reconnaissance and made strict preparations.

sentences.zh: 已，寇果至，營官王槐林等迎擊，大敗之。

translations.literal: Presently the bandits came as expected; Camp Officer Wang Huailin and others met them and inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: When the bandits came as expected, Camp Officer Wang Huailin and others met them and inflicted a great defeat.

sentences.zh: 別遣將大搜山林，自是首觀音山訖烏蘇里滿卡，千餘裡無寇踪。

translations.literal: He sent other generals to search the mountains and forests thoroughly; from Guanyin Mountain to the Wusuli frontier posts, more than a thousand li were free of bandits.
translations.idiomatic: He sent other generals to search the mountains thoroughly; from Guanyin Mountain to the Wusuli frontier posts, more than a thousand li were free of bandits.

sentences.zh: 又以撓力溝素窟匪，留兵鎮攝之。

translations.literal: Because bandits had long lurked in Naoli Gou, he left troops to pacify the area.
translations.idiomatic: Because bandits had long lurked in Naoli Gou, he left troops to pacify the area.

sentences.zh: 上以為能，降敕褒嘉。

translations.literal: The emperor considered him capable and issued an edict of praise.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor considered him capable and issued an edict of praise.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，卒於官，予黑龍江及立功省分建祠。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he died in office; temples were granted in Heilongjiang and the provinces where he had earned merit.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year he died in office; memorial temples were granted in Heilongjiang and the provinces where he had earned merit.

sentences.zh: 銘安，字鼎臣，葉赫那拉氏，內務府滿洲鑲黃旗人。

translations.literal: Ming An, styled Dingchen, of the Yehe Nara clan, a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner attached to the Imperial Household Department.
translations.idiomatic: Ming An, styled Dingchen, of the Yehe Nara clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner attached to the Imperial Household Department.

sentences.zh: 咸豐六年進士，選庶吉士，授編修，除贊善。

translations.literal: A jinshi in the sixth year of Xianfeng, selected as a bachelor of the Hanlin Academy, appointed compiler, then removed as tutor.
translations.idiomatic: A jinshi in the sixth year of Xianfeng, he entered the Hanlin as a bachelor, became a compiler, and was appointed a tutor.

sentences.zh: 累遷內閣學士，歷泰陵總兵、倉場侍郎。

translations.literal: He rose successively to grand secretary of the Grand Secretariat and served as commandant of Tailing and vice president of the Grain Transport Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to grand secretary of the Grand Secretariat and served as commandant of Tailing and vice president of the Grain Transport Bureau.

sentences.zh: 同治十三年，調盛京刑部。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Tongzhi he was transferred to the Mukden Board of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of Tongzhi he was transferred to the Mukden Board of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 德宗纘業，充頒詔朝鮮正使。

translations.literal: When the Guangxu Emperor succeeded, he served as chief envoy to proclaim the accession in Korea.
translations.idiomatic: When the Guangxu Emperor succeeded, he served as chief envoy to proclaim the accession in Korea.

sentences.zh: 光緒二年，勘事吉林，條上四事，曰：剿馬賊、禁賭博、設民官、稽荒地，上韙之，命署將軍。

translations.literal: In the second year of Guangxu he investigated affairs in Jilin and submitted four items: suppress horse bandits, ban gambling, establish civilian officials, and survey wasteland; the emperor approved and ordered him to act as military governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Guangxu he investigated Jilin and submitted four proposals: suppress horse bandits, ban gambling, establish civilian officials, and survey wasteland; the emperor approved and ordered him to act as military governor.

sentences.zh: 吉省武備久弛，寇盜充斥。

translations.literal: Jilin's military preparations had long been lax and bandits filled the province.
translations.idiomatic: Jilin's defenses had long been lax and bandits filled the province.

sentences.zh: 銘安蒞任，嚴治盜。

translations.literal: When Ming An took office he strictly suppressed banditry.
translations.idiomatic: On taking office Ming An strictly suppressed banditry.

sentences.zh: 复募獵戶為砲勇，號吉勝營。

translations.literal: He also recruited hunters as artillery troops, called the Jisheng Battalion.
translations.idiomatic: He also recruited hunters as artillery troops in a unit called the Jisheng Battalion.

sentences.zh: 先後檄統領穆隆阿、協領金福，分道追剿，斬馘甚眾。

translations.literal: He successively ordered Commandant Mulonga and Vice Commandant Jinfu to pursue in separate columns and took many heads.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Commandant Mulonga and Vice Commandant Jinfu to pursue in separate columns and took many heads.

sentences.zh: 益練西丹步隊八百，入山窮搜，寇勢漸蹙。

translations.literal: He further trained eight hundred Xidan infantry, searched the mountains thoroughly, and the bandits' strength gradually waned.
translations.idiomatic: He trained eight hundred Xidan infantry, searched the mountains thoroughly, and the bandits gradually weakened.

sentences.zh: 已，复捕治東山逸匪，擒誅金廠黨魁，軍威大振。

translations.literal: Presently he also captured fleeing bandits in the eastern hills and seized and executed the gold-mine ringleaders; military prestige greatly revived.
translations.idiomatic: He also captured fleeing bandits in the eastern hills and executed the gold-mine ringleaders; military prestige revived sharply.

sentences.zh: 默念吉省幅瀼四五千里，斷非十數委員能濟事；

translations.literal: He reflected that Jilin stretched four or five thousand li and could by no means be managed by a dozen or so commissioners alone;
translations.idiomatic: He reflected that Jilin stretched four or five thousand li and could not be managed by a dozen commissioners alone;

sentences.zh: 且旗員未諳民治，請破積習，調用漢官，部臣尼之，銘安抗疏力爭，始俞允。

translations.literal: moreover bannermen were unversed in civilian administration; he asked to break old habits and employ Chinese officials; ministry officials obstructed him; Ming An memorialized forcefully in opposition, and only then was approval granted.
translations.idiomatic: moreover bannermen were unversed in civilian rule; he asked to break old habits and employ Chinese officials; ministry officials obstructed him, but Ming An memorialized forcefully until approval was granted.

sentences.zh: 五年，實授。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he received formal appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he received formal appointment.

sentences.zh: 又言盜賊雖平，餘孽未靖，亟宜增置民官，畫疆分治。

translations.literal: He also said that although bandits were pacified, remnants were not settled, and civilian officials should urgently be added to divide the territory for administration.
translations.idiomatic: He also said that although bandits were pacified, remnants remained unsettled and civilian officials should urgently be added to divide the territory for administration.

sentences.zh: 先後奏改伯都訥同知、長春通判，理事，為撫民，置知府、巡道各一，賓州、五常同知二，雙城通判、伊通知州、敦化知縣各一，並請無分滿、漢。

translations.literal: He successively memorialized to change the subprefect of Boduna and the intendant of Changchun to civil administrators for pacifying the people; to establish one prefect and one circuit intendant; two subprefects for Binzhou and Wuchang; one intendant each for Shuangcheng, Yitong, and Dunhua; and asked that Manchu and Han not be distinguished.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized to convert the subprefect of Boduna and the intendant of Changchun into civil administrators; to establish a prefect and a circuit intendant; subprefects for Binzhou and Wuchang; and intendant posts for Shuangcheng, Yitong, and Dunhua; and asked that Manchu and Han not be distinguished.

sentences.zh: 又奏弛秧蓡禁，免山獸貢，增各旗義學，士民利賴之。

translations.literal: He also memorialized to relax the ginseng ban, exempt mountain-game tribute, and increase charity schools in each banner; scholars and common people benefited.
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized to relax the ginseng ban, exempt mountain-game tribute, and increase charity schools in each banner, to the benefit of scholars and common people.

sentences.zh: 東北與俄接壤，舊設卡倫，無兵駐守。

translations.literal: The northeast bordered Russia; frontier posts had been established but no troops were stationed.
translations.idiomatic: The northeast bordered Russia; frontier posts had been set up but no troops were stationed.

sentences.zh: 乃遣將分扼要塞，並築營伯力、紅土崖、雙城子，守以重兵，因上安內攘外方略，稱旨。

translations.literal: He then sent generals to hold key passes, built camps at Boli, Hongtuya, and Shuangchengzi, garrisoned them with heavy troops, and submitted a strategy to secure the interior and repel outsiders; the emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: He sent generals to hold key passes, built camps at Boli, Hongtuya, and Shuangchengzi, garrisoned them heavily, and submitted a strategy to secure the interior and repel outsiders; the emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 長春號難治，銘安稔知鍾彥才，奏請除通判，部臣以違例請下吏議，銘安盛氣抗辯，上兩解之。

translations.literal: Changchun was known as hard to govern; Ming An knew Zhong Yancai well and memorialized to appoint him intendant; ministry officials cited irregularity and asked for judicial inquiry; Ming An argued forcefully; the emperor settled it between them.
translations.idiomatic: Changchun was known as hard to govern; Ming An knew Zhong Yancai well and memorialized to appoint him intendant; ministry officials cited irregularity and asked for inquiry; Ming An argued forcefully, and the emperor settled it between them.

sentences.zh: 然銘安終不自安，引疾去。

translations.literal: Yet Ming An never felt secure and resigned on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Ming An never felt secure and resigned on grounds of illness.

sentences.zh: 尋坐失察屬吏受賄，降三級。

translations.literal: Soon he was demoted three ranks for failure to detect a subordinate's taking bribes.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was demoted three ranks for failing to detect a subordinate's bribery.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，上以治吉有功，部民感念，復故官。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, because of merit in governing Jilin and the people's gratitude, his former rank was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, for merit in governing Jilin and the people's gratitude, his former rank was restored.

sentences.zh: 明年，鄉舉重逢，加太子太保。

translations.literal: The next year, on the occasion of the provincial examination cycle, he was made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, on the provincial examination cycle, he was made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年，卒，年八十四，詔優恤，諡文肅。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xuantong he died, aged eighty-four; the throne ordered favorable condolence; posthumous title Wensu.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xuantong (1911) he died, aged eighty-four; the throne ordered special condolence, and he was given the posthumous title Wensu.

sentences.zh: 恭鏜，字振魁，博爾濟吉特氏，滿洲正黃旗人，大學士琦善子。

translations.literal: Gong Tang, style Zhenkui, of the Borjigit clan, a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner, son of Grand Secretary Qishan.
translations.idiomatic: Gong Tang, courtesy name Zhenkui, of the Borjigit clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner and son of Grand Secretary Qishan.

sentences.zh: 以任子授吏部主事。

translations.literal: By hereditary privilege he was made a principal clerk in the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: By hereditary privilege he was appointed a principal clerk in the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 累遷郎中，兼內務府銀庫員外郎，充總理各國事務衙門章京，出為湖北荊宜施道。

translations.literal: He rose successively to department director, concurrently served as assistant department director of the Treasury in the Imperial Household Department, served as a clerk in the Zongli Yamen, and went out as circuit intendant of Jing-Yi-Shi in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to department director, concurrently served in the Imperial Household Treasury, worked as a clerk in the Zongli Yamen, and was posted as circuit intendant of Jing-Yi-Shi in Hubei.

sentences.zh: 論捕獲江陵教匪功，加按察使銜。

translations.literal: For merit in capturing sect rebels at Jiangling, he received the brevet rank of provincial surveillance commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: For merit in capturing sect rebels at Jiangling, he was given the brevet rank of provincial surveillance commissioner.

sentences.zh: 同治十年，擢奉天府府尹，坐事降。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Tongzhi he was promoted to prefect of Fengtian Prefecture, then demoted for an offense.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Tongzhi (1871) he was promoted to prefect of Fengtian Prefecture, but was later demoted for an offense.

sentences.zh: 光緒三年，賞二等侍衛，充烏魯木齊領隊大臣。

translations.literal: In the third year of Guangxu he was granted Second Class Imperial Bodyguard and appointed commanding colonel at Urumqi.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Guangxu (1877) he was granted the rank of Second Class Imperial Bodyguard and appointed commanding colonel at Urumqi.

sentences.zh: 越二年，遷都統。

translations.literal: Two years later he was transferred to be military governor.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later he was transferred to military governor.

sentences.zh: 先是，陝回阿渾妥明客參將索煥章家。

translations.literal: Previously, a Shaanxi Muslim named Ahun Tuoming had lodged as a guest in the home of Deputy Commander Suo Huanzhang.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, a Shaanxi Muslim named Ahun Tuoming had been a guest in the household of Deputy Commander Suo Huanzhang.

sentences.zh: 煥章者，前甘州提督索文子也，素蓄異志。

translations.literal: Huanzhang was the son of the former Gansu provincial commander Suo Wen and had long harbored disloyal designs.
translations.idiomatic: Huanzhang was the son of the former Gansu provincial commander Suo Wen and had long harbored treasonous ambitions.

sentences.zh: 戍卒硃小桂告變，提督業普衝惑煥章言，誣斬小桂。

translations.literal: Garrison soldier Zhu Xiaogui reported the plot, but Provincial Commander Ye Puchong, misled by Huanzhang, had Xiaogui executed on false charges.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison soldier Zhu Xiaogui reported the conspiracy, but Provincial Commander Ye Puchong, misled by Huanzhang, had Xiaogui executed on trumped-up charges.

sentences.zh: 及煥章反，烏城陷，業普衝被害。

translations.literal: When Huanzhang rebelled, Wucheng fell and Ye Puchong was killed.
translations.idiomatic: When Huanzhang rebelled, Wucheng fell and Ye Puchong was killed.

sentences.zh: 至是恭鏜廉得實，請予平反。

translations.literal: By then Gong Tang had investigated and learned the truth, and memorialized for exoneration.
translations.idiomatic: By then Gong Tang had investigated and established the facts, and memorialized for exoneration.

sentences.zh: 奪索文榮典，分別卹小桂、業普衝及赴援殉難諸臣，人心稱快，賜頭品秩。

translations.literal: Suo Wen's posthumous honors were revoked; Xiaogui, Ye Puchong, and officials who died relieving the siege were separately pensioned; the people rejoiced, and Gong Tang was granted first-rank status.
translations.idiomatic: Suo Wen's posthumous honors were revoked; Xiaogui, Ye Puchong, and the officials who died on relief duty were separately pensioned; the public rejoiced, and Gong Tang was granted first-rank status.

sentences.zh: 九年，除西安將軍，病免。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was made general of Xi'an, then excused on account of illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was appointed general of Xi'an, then resigned on grounds of illness.

sentences.zh: 十二年，署黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he served as acting general of Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he served as acting general of Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 疏請舉辦漠河金礦，杜俄人覬覦。

translations.literal: He memorialized to develop gold mines on the Mohe River to forestall Russian covetousness.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized to develop gold mines on the Mohe River and thereby forestall Russian encroachment.

sentences.zh: 又建議墾荒十利，曰：儲國帑、濟民食、嚴保衛、便輯綏、裕經費、富徵收、集商賈、益釐稅、廣生聚、實邊備，詔不許。

translations.literal: He also proposed ten benefits of frontier reclamation: replenishing the treasury, feeding the people, tightening security, facilitating pacification, easing expenses, enriching revenue, drawing merchants, increasing customs dues, increasing population, and strengthening frontier defense; the edict did not approve.
translations.idiomatic: He also proposed ten benefits of opening wasteland: replenishing the treasury, feeding the people, tightening security, facilitating pacification, easing expenses, enriching revenue, drawing merchants, increasing customs dues, growing the population, and strengthening frontier defense; the edict did not approve.

sentences.zh: 十四年，實授。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he received formal appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he received formal appointment.

sentences.zh: 明年，移杭州，入覲，道卒天津，詔優恤。

translations.literal: The next year he was transferred to Hangzhou; on the road to audience he died at Tianjin; the throne ordered favorable condolence.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was transferred to Hangzhou; while traveling to court he died at Tianjin, and the throne ordered special condolence.

sentences.zh: 子瑞澂，自有傳。

translations.literal: His son Ruicheng has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: His son Ruicheng has his own biography.

sentences.zh: 慶裕，字蘭圃，喜塔臘氏，滿洲正白旗人。

translations.literal: Qing Yu, style Lanpu, of the Xitala clan, a Manchu of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Qing Yu, courtesy name Lanpu, of the Xitala clan, was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 以繙譯生員考取內閣中書，充軍機章京，兼總理各國事務衙門行走。

translations.literal: As a translation licentiate he passed the examination for Hanlin Attendant, served as a Grand Council clerk, and concurrently served in the Zongli Yamen.
translations.idiomatic: As a translation licentiate he passed the examination for Hanlin Attendant, served as a Grand Council clerk, and also worked in the Zongli Yamen.

sentences.zh: 從文祥赴奉天剿匪，還補侍讀。

translations.literal: He followed Wen Xiang to Fengtian to suppress bandits, then returned and was made a Hanlin reader.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Wen Xiang to Fengtian to suppress bandits, then returned and was appointed a Hanlin reader.

sentences.zh: 出知湖北鄖陽府。

translations.literal: He went out as prefect of Yunyang in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: He was posted as prefect of Yunyang in Hubei.

sentences.zh: 追錄平捻功，晉道員。

translations.literal: For recorded merit in pacifying the Nian rebels he was promoted to circuit intendant.
translations.idiomatic: For recorded merit in pacifying the Nian rebels he was promoted to circuit intendant.

sentences.zh: 光緒元年，擢奉天府府尹。
