translations.literal: The former deputy military governor Erqing'e asked that it be reclaimed when the lease term expired.
translations.idiomatic: The former deputy military governor Erqing'e requested that it be reclaimed when the lease expired.

sentences.zh: 總署以俄使有續借之請，函詢情形。

translations.literal: The Zongli Yamen, because the Russian minister had requested renewal of the lease, inquired by dispatch about the situation.
translations.idiomatic: Because the Russian minister had requested a lease renewal, the Zongli Yamen inquired by dispatch about the situation.

sentences.zh: 長庚詳陳利弊，謂此山關係重大，急應收回。

translations.literal: Chang Geng set forth advantages and disadvantages in detail, saying this mountain was of great importance and should urgently be recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Geng set forth the advantages and disadvantages in detail, arguing that the mountain was of great importance and should be recovered without delay.

sentences.zh: 隨遣員赴塔城與俄領事會商，堅持人隨地歸之約，卒收回。

translations.literal: He then sent an officer to Tacheng to negotiate with the Russian consul, insisting on the pact that people follow the land, and in the end recovered it.
translations.idiomatic: He then sent an officer to Tacheng to negotiate with the Russian consul, insisting on the principle that sovereignty follows territory, and eventually recovered the mountain.

sentences.zh: 二十年，甘回作亂，官軍兜剿。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, Gansu Muslims rebelled and government troops encircled and suppressed them.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year (1894), Gansu Muslims rebelled, and government troops encircled and suppressed them.

sentences.zh: 賊不能得志於甘，欲循白彥虎故事，西竄新疆，由伊犁遁俄境。

translations.literal: The rebels could not succeed in Gansu and wished to follow Bai Yanhu's precedent, fleeing west into Xinjiang and escaping through Ili into Russian territory.
translations.idiomatic: Unable to prevail in Gansu, the rebels sought to follow Bai Yanhu's example by fleeing west into Xinjiang and escaping through Ili into Russian territory.

sentences.zh: 長庚諜知，遣兵扼守珠勒都斯等地，賊不能越，遂就擒於羅布淖爾。

translations.literal: Chang Geng learned by espionage, sent troops to hold Juldus and other places; the rebels could not pass and were finally captured at Lop Nur.
translations.idiomatic: Learning this through intelligence, Chang Geng sent troops to hold Juldus and other passes; the rebels could not break through and were finally captured at Lop Nur.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，命兼鑲藍旗漢軍都統。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, he was ordered concurrently to serve as military governor of the Bordered Blue Banner Chinese Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year (1896), he was appointed concurrently as military governor of the Bordered Blue Banner Chinese Army.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，拳匪肇亂，俄人調兵入伊。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, the Boxers rose in disorder and Russians moved troops into Ili.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year (1900), the Boxer uprising began and Russian troops entered Ili.

sentences.zh: 長庚與俄領事交涉，凡教堂及俄人財產，力任保護，諭令退兵，人心乃定。

translations.literal: Chang Geng negotiated with the Russian consul, personally undertook protection of all churches and Russian property, ordered withdrawal of troops, and popular sentiment then settled.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Geng negotiated with the Russian consul, personally guaranteed the protection of churches and Russian property, urged the Russians to withdraw their troops, and thereby restored calm.

sentences.zh: 調成都將軍，未之任，奉電旨飭赴阿爾泰山查勘界址。

translations.literal: He was transferred to be military governor of Chengdu but did not take up the post; by telegraphic decree he was ordered to go to the Altai Mountains to survey boundary markers.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to military governor of Chengdu but never took up the post; by telegraphic decree he was ordered to the Altai Mountains to survey the boundary.

sentences.zh: 旋內召，授兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Soon he was summoned to the capital and appointed Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon summoned to the capital and appointed Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，复授伊犁將軍。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year, he was again appointed military governor of Ili.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year (1905), he was again appointed military governor of Ili.

sentences.zh: 疏陳伊犁應辦事宜，並言籌餉練兵，必合新疆全省籌畫。

translations.literal: In a memorial he set forth matters that should be undertaken at Ili, and also said that raising funds and training troops must be planned for all of Xinjiang as a whole.
translations.idiomatic: In a memorial he outlined what should be done at Ili and argued that raising funds and training troops required planning for all of Xinjiang as a whole.

sentences.zh: 將軍事權不屬，莫若裁去新疆巡撫、伊犁將軍，增設總督兼管巡撫事宜，庶呼應靈而事權一。

translations.literal: Since military authority did not belong to one office, it would be best to abolish the Xinjiang governor and the Ili military governor and add a governor-general also managing governor affairs, so that response would be nimble and authority unified.
translations.idiomatic: Because military authority was divided, he proposed abolishing the posts of Xinjiang governor and Ili military governor and creating a governor-general who would also handle civil administration, so that command could respond swiftly and authority would be unified.

sentences.zh: 又籌擬北方興屯、置省事宜，請築西安至蘭州、歸化至包頭、包頭至古城各鐵路，皆不果行。

translations.literal: He also planned northern land reclamation and provincial establishment, requesting railways from Xi'an to Lanzhou, Guihua to Baotou, and Baotou to Gucheng; none were carried out.
translations.idiomatic: He also drew up plans for land reclamation and provincial organization in the north, proposing railways from Xi'an to Lanzhou, Guihua to Baotou, and Baotou to Gucheng—but none of these projects went forward.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年，遷陝甘總督。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuantong, he was transferred to governor-general of Shaanxi and Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xuantong (1909), he was transferred to governor-general of Shaanxi and Gansu.

sentences.zh: 三年，武昌事起，西安等處繼之。

translations.literal: In the third year, the Wuchang affair arose and Xi'an and other places followed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year (1911), the uprising at Wuchang broke out, and Xi'an and other cities followed.

sentences.zh: 前陝甘總督升允奉命督辦軍務，事略定。

translations.literal: The former governor-general Sheng Yun was ordered to supervise military affairs; matters were somewhat settled.
translations.idiomatic: The former governor-general Sheng Yun was ordered to supervise military affairs, and the situation was brought partly under control.

sentences.zh: 遜位旨下，長庚乃將總督印交布政使趙惟熙而去。

translations.literal: When the abdication edict was issued, Chang Geng handed the governor-general's seal to Provincial Administration Commissioner Zhao Weixi and departed.
translations.idiomatic: When the abdication edict was issued, Chang Geng handed the governor-general's seal to Provincial Administration Commissioner Zhao Weixi and left office.

sentences.zh: 越四年卒，諡恭厚。

translations.literal: Four years later he died; posthumous title Gonghou.
translations.idiomatic: He died four years later and was given the posthumous title Gonghou.

sentences.zh: 文海，字仲瀛，費莫氏，滿洲鑲紅旗人。

translations.literal: Wen Hai, style Zhongying, of the Feimo clan, a Manchu of the Bordered Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Hai, courtesy name Zhongying, of the Feimo clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 以繙譯舉人考取內閣中書，充軍機章京，遷侍讀。

translations.literal: As a translation licentiate he passed the examination for Secretariat drafter, served as a Grand Council clerk, and was promoted reader-in-waiting.
translations.idiomatic: As a translation licentiate he passed the examination for Secretariat drafter, served as a Grand Council clerk, and was promoted to reader-in-waiting.

sentences.zh: 光緒九年，轉御史。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Guangxu he was transferred to censor.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Guangxu (1883) he was transferred to censor.

sentences.zh: 建言培養人才，宜令中外大臣杜徇情，勵廉恥，以植其本，上嘉納焉。

translations.literal: He memorialized on cultivating talent, saying ministers at court and abroad should shut out favoritism and encourage integrity and shame to plant the root; the throne praised and accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized on cultivating talent, urging ministers at court and abroad to shut out favoritism and encourage integrity and a sense of shame as the foundation of governance; the throne praised and accepted his advice.

sentences.zh: 十二年，巡視北城。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, he inspected the North City.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year (1886) he inspected the North City.

sentences.zh: 以兄文治授詹事，依例迴避，調戶部郎中。

translations.literal: Because his elder brother Wen Zhi was appointed Junior Tutor, by regulation he withdrew and was transferred to department director in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: When his elder brother Wen Zhi was appointed Junior Tutor, he withdrew by regulation and was transferred to department director in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 十四年，出知貴州安順府，調貴陽。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, he went out as prefect of Anshun in Guizhou and was transferred to Guiyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year (1888) he was appointed prefect of Anshun in Guizhou and later transferred to Guiyang.

sentences.zh: 所蒞有聲。

translations.literal: Wherever he served he gained renown.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever he served he earned a strong reputation.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，數遷至按察使，尋加副都統，充駐藏辦事大臣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, after several promotions he reached provincial surveillance commissioner; soon he received the additional post of deputy military governor and was appointed Resident Commissioner in Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year (1896) he rose through several posts to provincial surveillance commissioner; he was soon given the additional rank of deputy military governor and appointed Resident Commissioner in Tibet.

sentences.zh: 既至，即上言叛番雖靖，餘孽猶存，兵未可罷，願自任剿辦。

translations.literal: Once he arrived, he immediately memorialized that although rebel Tibetans had been pacified, remnants remained and troops could not be dismissed; he wished to take personal charge of suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Upon arrival he immediately memorialized that although the Tibetan rebels had been pacified, remnants remained and troops could not be stood down; he volunteered to take personal charge of the suppression.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，呼圖克圖第穆構康巴喇嘛用邪術咒詛達賴。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, Hutuktu Dimu incited Khampa lamas to curse the Dalai Lama with evil arts.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year (1899), Hutuktu Dimu incited Khampa lamas to curse the Dalai Lama with sorcery.

sentences.zh: 文海曰：「此關風化，不可不有以懲之也。

translations.literal: Wen Hai said: "This concerns public morals; there must be punishment."
translations.idiomatic: Wen Hai said, "This touches public morals; there must be some punishment."

sentences.zh: 」乃奏請奪其名號。

translations.literal: "He then memorialized requesting deprivation of his title.
translations.idiomatic: He then memorialized requesting that Dimu's religious title be stripped.

sentences.zh: 已而野番出掠博窩，地為川、藏孔道，行旅苦之。

translations.literal: Before long wild tribesmen came out to plunder Bowo; the place was a vital route between Sichuan and Tibet, and travelers suffered.
translations.idiomatic: Before long wild tribesmen raided Bowo, a vital route between Sichuan and Tibet, to the great distress of travelers.

sentences.zh: 官軍入昂多往捕，彼即扼縮隆岡來路，崛強莫能製。

translations.literal: When government troops entered Angduo to pursue capture, they would choke the Suolonggang approach and grow defiant beyond control.
translations.idiomatic: When government troops entered Angduo to pursue them, the tribesmen would block the Suolonggang pass and grow so defiant that they could not be subdued.

sentences.zh: 文海率眾進擊，別遣通番語者繞道叩其壁，宣播朝威，反覆開喻。

translations.literal: Wen Hai led the host forward to attack and separately sent men who knew tribal languages by a detour to knock at their stockades, proclaiming imperial majesty and repeatedly exhorting them.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Hai led his forces forward in attack and separately sent men fluent in tribal languages by a detour to approach their stockades, proclaiming imperial authority and reasoning with them again and again.

sentences.zh: 於是上博窩業魯第巴宿木宗，中博窩雨茹寺，下博窩蒲隆、瓊多諸寺，皆相率乞款附，數月而事定，賜頭品服。

translations.literal: Thereupon Upper Bowo Yeludiba Sumuzong, Middle Bowo Yuru Monastery, and Lower Bowo Pulong, Qiongduo, and other monasteries all came in succession to beg peace and submit; within months the affair was settled, and he was granted a first-rank official hat.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the monasteries of Upper Bowo Yeludiba Sumuzong, Middle Bowo Yuru, and Lower Bowo Pulong, Qiongduo, and others all submitted in succession; within months the affair was settled, and he was granted a first-rank official hat.

sentences.zh: 未幾遘疾，請入川療治，卒於塗。

translations.literal: Before long he fell ill, requested to enter Sichuan for treatment, and died on the road.
translations.idiomatic: He soon fell ill, asked to enter Sichuan for treatment, and died on the journey.

sentences.zh: 依尚書例賜卹，予入城治喪。

translations.literal: By ministerial precedent he was granted condolence and permission to hold funeral rites within the city.
translations.idiomatic: By ministerial precedent he was granted condolence and permission for funeral rites to be held within the city.

sentences.zh: 鳳全，字茀堂，滿洲鑲黃旗人，荊州駐防。

translations.literal: Feng Quan, style Futang, a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner, garrisoned at Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Quan, courtesy name Futang, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner garrisoned at Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 以舉人入貲為知縣，銓四川。

translations.literal: As a licentiate he purchased appointment as magistrate and was assigned to Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: As a licentiate he purchased appointment as magistrate and was assigned to Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 光緒二年，權知開縣，至則使吏捕仇開正。

translations.literal: In the second year of Guangxu he served as acting magistrate of Kai County; upon arrival he had clerks arrest Qiu Kaizheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Guangxu (1876) he served as acting magistrate of Kai County; upon arrival he had his clerks arrest Qiu Kaizheng.

sentences.zh: 開正故無賴，痛以重法繩之，卒改為善。

translations.literal: Kaizheng had been a rogue; Feng Quan sternly applied heavy law and in the end he reformed to goodness.
translations.idiomatic: Kaizheng had been a notorious rogue; Feng Quan punished him severely under the law until he finally reformed.

sentences.zh: 李氏為邑豪族，其族人倚勢，所為多不法。

translations.literal: The Li clan were local magnates; their kinsmen relied on power and their conduct was mostly unlawful.
translations.idiomatic: The Li were a powerful local clan whose kinsmen relied on their influence and behaved unlawfully in many ways.

sentences.zh: 鳳全直法行治，雖豪必夷，以故人人惴恐。

translations.literal: Feng Quan enforced the law directly; even the powerful he leveled, so everyone lived in fear.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Quan enforced the law without favor; even the powerful he brought low, so that everyone lived in fear of him.

sentences.zh: 歷成都、綿竹，補蒲江，署崇慶州，一如治開。

translations.literal: He served at Chengdu and Mianzhu, was appointed to Pujiang, and acted as prefect of Chongqing—all as when governing Kai.
translations.idiomatic: He served at Chengdu and Mianzhu, was appointed to Pujiang, and acted as prefect of Chongqing—governing each place as he had Kai.

sentences.zh: 舉治行第一，擢工卩州直隸州。

translations.literal: His administrative record was ranked first and he was promoted to Gongzhou Direct Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: His administrative record was ranked first in the province, and he was promoted to Gongzhou Direct Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，調資州。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, he was transferred to Zizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year (1897) he was transferred to Zizhou.

sentences.zh: 大足縣餘蠻子亂起，其黨唐翠屏等構眾入境。

translations.literal: The Yumanzi rebellion arose in Dazu County; his followers Tang Cuiping and others gathered crowds to cross the border.
translations.idiomatic: The Yumanzi rebellion broke out in Dazu County; his follower Tang Cuiping and others raised bands to cross the border.

sentences.zh: 鳳全乃治城防，設間諜，練鄉勇，聯客軍，謀定寇至，亟遣軍間道襲擊。

translations.literal: Feng Quan then strengthened city defenses, set spies, trained militia, allied with guest troops, and when bandits came sent troops by a hidden route to strike.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Quan strengthened the city defenses, set spies, trained militia, allied with outside troops, and when the rebels came sent forces by a hidden route to strike them.

sentences.zh: 戰太平場，捕斬略盡。

translations.literal: At Taiping Field they fought; capture and execution were nearly complete.
translations.idiomatic: They fought at Taiping Field; nearly all the rebels were captured and executed.

sentences.zh: 复越境搜治餘黨，不兩月而事寧。

translations.literal: He again crossed the border to search out remaining partisans; within two months the affair was settled.
translations.idiomatic: He crossed the border again to hunt down remaining partisans, and within two months the disturbance was settled.

sentences.zh: 州屬患水祲，民多失業，設法賑濟之，全活甚眾。

translations.literal: The prefecture suffered flood and famine; many people lost livelihood; he devised methods of relief and many were preserved alive.
translations.idiomatic: When flood and famine struck the prefecture and many lost their livelihoods, he devised relief measures and saved a great number of lives.

sentences.zh: 再以治行聞，調署瀘州。

translations.literal: Again his administrative record became known and he was transferred to act at Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: His administrative record again won notice, and he was transferred to act as prefect of Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，權知嘉定府。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, he acted as prefect of Jiading.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year (1902) he served as acting prefect of Jiading.

sentences.zh: 緣江會匪嘯聚，既蒞事，舉團練，嚴治通匪土豪，居民莫敢玩法。

translations.literal: Along the river secret-society bandits gathered; once he took office he raised militia and strictly punished local magnates who communicated with bandits; residents did not dare break the law.
translations.idiomatic: Secret-society bandits had gathered along the river; once he took office he raised militia and strictly punished local magnates who colluded with them, so that residents did not dare break the law.

sentences.zh: 無何，拳匪延入蜀，嘉定當水陸衝，郡中一夕數驚。

translations.literal: Before long the Boxers spread into Shu; Jiading lay at a land-and-water crossroads and the prefecture was alarmed several times in a single night.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the Boxer movement spread into Sichuan; Jiading lay at a land-and-water crossroads, and the prefecture was thrown into alarm several times in a single night.

sentences.zh: 鳳全內固人心，外嚴拒守。

translations.literal: Feng Quan inwardly steadied popular sentiment and outwardly maintained strict defense.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Quan steadied popular sentiment within the city and maintained strict defenses without.

sentences.zh: 嘗提一旅師四出游弋，匪不敢近。

translations.literal: He once led a brigade on patrol in all directions; bandits did not dare approach.
translations.idiomatic: He once led a brigade on patrol in all directions, and the bandits did not dare approach.

sentences.zh: 故鄰境多破碎，惟嘉郡差全，各國僑民多樂就之，繇是名大著。

translations.literal: Therefore neighboring districts were mostly shattered while Jiading alone remained largely intact; foreign residents were glad to come to him, and thereby his fame grew great.
translations.idiomatic: Neighboring districts were mostly devastated while Jiading alone remained largely intact; foreign residents were glad to seek his protection, and his fame spread widely.

sentences.zh: 岑春煊性嚴厲，喜彈劾，屬吏鮮當意，獨亟賞鳳全，一再論薦。

translations.literal: Cen Chunxuan was stern by nature and fond of impeachment; subordinates rarely pleased him, yet he alone prized Feng Quan highly and recommended him repeatedly.
translations.idiomatic: Cen Chunxuan was stern by nature and fond of impeachment; few subordinates pleased him, yet he prized Feng Quan highly and recommended him again and again.

sentences.zh: 遷成綿龍茂道，特加副都統。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the Cheng-Mian-Long-Mao Circuit and specially given the additional rank of deputy military governor.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to intendant of the Cheng-Mian-Long-Mao Circuit and given the additional rank of deputy military governor.

sentences.zh: 三十年，充駐藏幫辦大臣。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, he was appointed Assistant Resident Commissioner in Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year (1904) he was appointed Assistant Resident Commissioner in Tibet.

sentences.zh: 行抵巴塘，見土司侵細民，喇嘛尤橫恣，久蔑視大臣。

translations.literal: Reaching Batang, he saw native chiefs encroach on common people and lamas were especially overbearing, long despising the commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: When he reached Batang he found native chiefs encroaching on common people and lamas especially overbearing, having long held the imperial commissioner in contempt.

sentences.zh: 鳳全以為縱之則滋驕，後且嬰患，因是有暫停剃度、限定人數之議。

translations.literal: Feng Quan thought that indulgence would breed arrogance and trouble would follow later; therefore there arose proposals temporarily to halt ordinations and limit numbers.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Quan believed that indulgence would breed arrogance and bring trouble later; he therefore proposed temporarily halting ordinations and limiting the number of monks.

sentences.zh: 喇嘛銜之深，遂潛通土司，嗾番匪播流言，阻墾務，漸至戕營勇，燔教堂，勢洶洶。

translations.literal: The lamas bore deep resentment, then secretly communicated with native chiefs, incited tribal bandits to spread rumors, obstructed reclamation, and gradually came to kill camp soldiers and burn churches—the momentum grew fierce.
translations.idiomatic: The lamas bore deep resentment, secretly colluded with native chiefs, and incited tribal bandits to spread rumors, obstruct reclamation, kill camp soldiers, and burn churches—until the situation grew explosive.

sentences.zh: 鳳全率衛兵五百人往，至紅亭子，伏突起，戰良久，被害。

translations.literal: Feng Quan led five hundred guards forward; at Hongtingzi an ambush sprang up; they fought long and he was killed.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Quan led five hundred guards forward; at Hongtingzi an ambush sprang up; after a long fight he was killed.

sentences.zh: 事聞，予建祠，諡威愍。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, a temple was granted in his honor; posthumous title Weimin.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached the court, a memorial temple was granted in his honor and he received the posthumous title Weimin.

sentences.zh: 繼室李佳氏留成都，聞變，率子忠順馳入打箭爐辨遺骸，隨喪歸省垣。

translations.literal: His second wife, Lady Li née Jia, remained in Chengdu; hearing of the disaster, she led her son Zhongshun in haste into Dartsendo to identify the remains and returned with the coffin to the provincial capital.
translations.idiomatic: His second wife, Lady Li née Jia, remained in Chengdu; on hearing of the disaster she led her son Zhongshun in haste to Dartsendo to identify his remains and returned with the coffin to the provincial capital.

sentences.zh: 祠既成，乃觴將軍、總督以下官及文武士紳，告靈安主，慨然曰：「吾可以見先夫於地下矣！

translations.literal: When the temple was completed, she entertained the military governor, governor-general, and officials civil and military below them, announced the spirit had been settled, and said with emotion: "I can now meet my late husband in the underworld!"
translations.idiomatic: When the temple was completed, she entertained the military governor, governor-general, and officials civil and military, announced that his spirit was at rest, and said with emotion, "I can now meet my late husband in the underworld!"

sentences.zh: 」事畢，夜赴荷池死，獲附祀。

translations.literal: When the affair was finished, at night she went to Lotus Pond and died; she was granted attached sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: When the rites were finished, she went to Lotus Pond that night and drowned herself; she was granted the honor of attached sacrifice in his temple.

sentences.zh: 鳳全清操峻特，號剛直，然性忭急，少權變，不能與番眾委蛇，故終及難雲。

translations.literal: Feng Quan's integrity was severe and exceptional; he was known as unyielding, yet his nature was impatient and he lacked flexibility, unable to deal tactfully with tribal peoples—thus he finally met calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Quan was known for stern integrity and unyielding conduct, yet he was impatient and inflexible, unable to deal tactfully with tribal peoples—and so met his end in disaster.

sentences.zh: 增祺，字瑞堂，伊拉里氏，滿洲鑲白旗人，密雲駐防。

translations.literal: Zeng Qi, style Ruitang, of the Iri clan, a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner, garrisoned at Miyun.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Qi, courtesy name Ruitang, of the Iri clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner garrisoned at Miyun.

sentences.zh: 以佐領調黑龍江，佐練兵事，歷至齊齊哈爾副都統。

translations.literal: As an assistant commandant he was transferred to Heilongjiang, assisted in training troops, and rose to deputy military governor of Qiqihar.
translations.idiomatic: As an assistant commandant he was transferred to Heilongjiang, assisted in training troops, and rose to deputy military governor of Qiqihar.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十年，署將軍。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year of Guangxu he acted as military governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year of Guangxu (1894) he served as acting military governor.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，擢福州將軍，充船政大臣，兼署閩浙總督，旋遷盛京將軍。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, he was promoted military governor of Fuzhou, appointed Superintendent of the Navy Yard, concurrently acted as governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang, and soon was transferred to military governor of Shengjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year (1898) he was promoted to military governor of Fuzhou, appointed Superintendent of the Navy Yard, concurrently served as governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang, and was soon transferred to military governor of Shengjing.

sentences.zh: 奉天自中日戰後，副都統榮和、壽長編練仁字、育字兩軍，營務廢弛，增祺奏請派員查辦，上命李秉衡往查，奪二人職，交部治罪，軍制肅然。

translations.literal: Since the Sino-Japanese War in Fengtian, Deputy Military Governors Ronghe and Shouchang had organized the Ren and Yu armies; camp affairs were lax; Zeng Qi memorialized requesting dispatch of an investigator; the throne ordered Li Bingheng to investigate, stripped both of office, and referred them to the ministry for punishment; military discipline was restored.
translations.idiomatic: After the Sino-Japanese War, Deputy Military Governors Ronghe and Shouchang had organized the Ren and Yu armies, but camp discipline had grown lax; Zeng Qi memorialized for an investigation; the throne sent Li Bingheng, who stripped both men of office and referred them for punishment, and military discipline was restored.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，拳匪亂作，副都統晉昌率眾附和，增祺不能阻，遂啟戰釁。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, the Boxer disorder arose; Deputy Military Governor Jin Chang led the crowd in joining it; Zeng Qi could not stop them and war was thus begun.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year (1900) the Boxer uprising broke out; Deputy Military Governor Jin Chang led the populace in supporting it; Zeng Qi could not restrain them, and war was thus begun.

sentences.zh: 奉省自日還遼南，旅順、大連既轉歸俄租，复築鐵道，沿路皆駐俄兵。

translations.literal: Since Japan returned southern Liaodong to Fengtian, Lüshun and Dalian had passed to Russian lease; railways were built again and Russian troops were stationed all along the line.
translations.idiomatic: Since Japan had returned southern Liaodong, Lüshun and Dalian had passed into Russian lease; railways were built anew and Russian troops were stationed all along the line.

sentences.zh: 戰累挫，蓋平、熊岳先後失守。

translations.literal: Battles were repeatedly lost; Gaiping and Xiongyue fell in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Battles were repeatedly lost; Gaiping and Xiongyue fell in succession.

sentences.zh: 增祺先以敵強兵脆，大局不支，連電上達，並照會旅順俄水師提督、營口俄領事，磋商停戰，不果。

translations.literal: Zeng Qi, seeing the enemy strong and troops weak and the overall situation untenable, sent repeated telegrams upward and also notified the Russian naval commander at Lüshun and the Russian consul at Yingkou to negotiate a ceasefire, without success.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing the enemy strong, his troops weak, and the overall situation untenable, Zeng Qi sent repeated telegrams to the court and also notified the Russian naval commander at Lüshun and the Russian consul at Yingkou to negotiate a ceasefire, but without success.

sentences.zh: 俄兵遂抵省城，諸軍皆潰。

translations.literal: Russian troops then reached the provincial capital and all armies dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: Russian troops then reached the provincial capital and all Qing forces dispersed.

sentences.zh: 增祺奏請恭奉盛京大內尊藏聖容、太廟冊寶出城。

translations.literal: Zeng Qi memorialized requesting reverent escort of the sacred portraits and ancestral tablets and seals from the Shengjing inner palace and the Imperial Ancestral Temple out of the city.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Qi memorialized requesting that the sacred portraits, ancestral tablets, and seals from the Shengjing inner palace and Imperial Ancestral Temple be reverently escorted out of the city.

sentences.zh: 俄兵至，招增祺還，商議善後。

translations.literal: When Russian troops arrived, they summoned Zeng Qi back to discuss aftermath.
translations.idiomatic: When Russian troops arrived, they summoned Zeng Qi back to discuss arrangements for the aftermath.

sentences.zh: 增祺往旅順，與俄議訂奉天交地暫約九條，以荒謬交嚴議，詔革職，尋仍留任。

translations.literal: Zeng Qi went to Lüshun and with Russia concluded the nine-article provisional agreement on handover in Fengtian; because it was absurd he was severely criticized; an edict stripped him of office, but soon he was retained in post.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Qi went to Lüshun and with Russia concluded the nine-article provisional agreement on the handover of Fengtian; because the terms were deemed absurd he was severely criticized and stripped of office by edict, though he was soon retained in his post.

sentences.zh: 諭楊儒向俄外部商改，以吏治兵權不失自主為要。

translations.literal: Yang Ru was instructed to negotiate revisions with the Russian foreign ministry, taking preservation of autonomous civil and military administration as essential.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Ru was instructed to negotiate revisions with the Russian foreign ministry, with preservation of autonomous civil and military administration as the essential point.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，交收東三省條約始成。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, the treaty for recovery of the Three Eastern Provinces was finally concluded.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year (1902) the treaty for the recovery of the Three Eastern Provinces was finally concluded.

sentences.zh: 俄兵駐奉數年，遇事強橫，無復公理，增祺隱忍周旋，憂勞備至，至是駐兵始退。

translations.literal: Russian troops had been stationed in Fengtian for years, overbearing in every affair without regard for justice; Zeng Qi endured and maneuvered, worry and labor reaching their utmost; only then did the stationed troops withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: Russian troops had been stationed in Fengtian for years, overbearing in every affair without regard for justice; Zeng Qi endured and maneuvered through endless worry and labor until the troops finally withdrew.

sentences.zh: 未幾，復有俄日之戰，朝旨守中立。

translations.literal: Before long there was again war between Russia and Japan; the court's order was to maintain neutrality.
translations.idiomatic: Before long war broke out again between Russia and Japan; the court ordered strict neutrality.

sentences.zh: 增祺嚴飭文武官吏堅明約束，並告兩國主兵者勿得犯中立。

translations.literal: Zeng Qi strictly ordered civil and military officials to uphold clear constraints and also informed commanders on both sides not to violate neutrality.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Qi strictly ordered civil and military officials to uphold neutrality and informed the commanders of both sides that they must not violate it.

sentences.zh: 日兵迫省亟，勸俄兵先退，日兵官始入城，省城倖免戰禍。

translations.literal: Japanese troops pressed the province urgently; he urged Russian troops to withdraw first; Japanese officers then entered the city and the provincial capital narrowly escaped war.
translations.idiomatic: As Japanese troops pressed the province urgently, he urged the Russian troops to withdraw first; Japanese officers then entered the city, and the provincial capital narrowly escaped devastation by war.

sentences.zh: 三十年冬，諭增祺賑撫東三省難民，並發內帑三十萬賑之。

translations.literal: In the winter of the thirtieth year, an edict ordered Zeng Qi to relieve refugees in the Three Eastern Provinces and issued three hundred thousand taels from the inner treasury for relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the thirtieth year (1904), an edict ordered Zeng Qi to relieve refugees in the Three Eastern Provinces and issued three hundred thousand taels from the inner treasury for relief.

sentences.zh: 明年，懿旨復發內帑三十萬賑恤。

translations.literal: The next year, an empress-dowager edict again issued three hundred thousand taels for relief and condolence.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, an empress-dowager edict issued another three hundred thousand taels for relief and condolence.

sentences.zh: 增祺招集流亡，商民復業。

translations.literal: Zeng Qi gathered the displaced; merchants and people resumed their trades.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Qi gathered the displaced population, and merchants and townspeople resumed their trades.

sentences.zh: 頗留意吏治，先後增設洮南、海龍、遼源、開通、靖安、西安、西豐等府縣。

translations.literal: He paid considerable attention to administration; successively he added prefectures and counties such as Taonan, Hailong, Liaoyuan, Kaitong, Jing'an, Xi'an, and Xifeng.
translations.idiomatic: He paid considerable attention to administration and successively established prefectures and counties including Taonan, Hailong, Liaoyuan, Kaitong, Jing'an, Xi'an, and Xifeng.

sentences.zh: 凡牧廠、圍場及蒙荒，逐漸放墾。

translations.literal: All pasture farms, hunting enclosures, and Mongol wasteland were gradually opened to reclamation.
translations.idiomatic: Pasture farms, imperial hunting preserves, and Mongol frontier wasteland were gradually opened to cultivation.

sentences.zh: 奉省財政素絀，徵榷一切，向無定章，咸豐後始辦貨釐，光緒初始辦鹽釐。

translations.literal: Fengtian's finances had long been deficient; levies and transit duties of every kind had no fixed rules; only after Xianfeng were commodity transit duties instituted, and only at the start of Guangxu salt transit duties.
translations.idiomatic: Fengtian's finances had long been stretched thin; taxes and transit duties had never been governed by fixed rules—commodity likin was instituted only after the Xianfeng era, and salt likin only at the beginning of Guangxu.

sentences.zh: 增祺銳意清理，籌辦糧、酒、煙、藥各稅，明年規章，變通鹽法，就廠徵稅，歲入漸增。

translations.literal: Zeng Qi was keen to put matters in order, drew up grain, wine, tobacco, and medicine taxes, established regulations the following year, reformed the salt law to collect tax at the depots, and annual revenue gradually increased.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Qi pressed hard to put fiscal affairs in order, instituting taxes on grain, wine, tobacco, and medicine, drafting regulations the following year, reforming the salt monopoly to levy taxes at the production depots—and annual revenue gradually rose.

sentences.zh: 尤嚴治盜，以增官設治為弭盜清源之本。

translations.literal: He was especially strict in suppressing banditry, taking the addition of officials and establishment of administration as the root of quelling robbers and clearing the source.
translations.idiomatic: He was especially strict in suppressing banditry, holding that adding officials and extending civil administration was the fundamental way to quell lawlessness at its source.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，以憂免。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year, he was released from office on account of bereavement.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year (1905) he left office to observe mourning for a parent.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，授寧夏將軍，改正白旗蒙古都統。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year, he was appointed General of Ningxia and reassigned as Mongol Lieutenant-General of the Bordered White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year (1907) he was appointed General of Ningxia and reassigned as lieutenant-general of the Bordered White Banner Mongols.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年，遷廣州將軍，兼署兩廣總督。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuantong, he was transferred as General of Guangzhou and concurrently acted as Governor-General of the Two Guang.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xuantong (1909) he was transferred to General of Guangzhou and concurrently served as acting Governor-General of Guangdong and Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 三年，調京，仍授都統，兼弼德院顧問大臣，旋去職。

translations.literal: In the third year, he was transferred to the capital, again granted lieutenant-general's rank, and concurrently made a counsel member of the Bide Academy, soon leaving office.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year (1911) he was recalled to the capital, again given lieutenant-general's rank and appointed counsel of the Bide Academy, but soon left office.

sentences.zh: 越八年，卒，諡簡愨。

translations.literal: Eight years later he died; posthumous title Jianque.
translations.idiomatic: Eight years later he died and was granted the posthumous title Jianque ("Simple and Resolute").

sentences.zh: 貽穀，字藹人，烏雅氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人。

translations.literal: Yi Gu, style Airen, of the Uya clan, a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Gu, courtesy name Airen, of the Uya clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 光緒元年舉人。

translations.literal: In the first year of Guangxu he passed the provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the provincial civil examination in the first year of Guangxu (1875).

sentences.zh: 以主事分兵部，晉員外郎。

translations.literal: As a principal secretary he was assigned to the Board of War and promoted to vice-director.
translations.idiomatic: He entered the Board of War as a principal secretary and was promoted to vice-director.

sentences.zh: 十八年，成進士，選庶吉士，授編修，累遷內閣學士。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he passed the metropolitan examination, was selected a Hanlin bachelor, appointed compiler, and rose successively to Hanlin Academician of the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year (1892) he passed the metropolitan examination, was selected a Hanlin bachelor, appointed compiler, and rose through successive posts to Hanlin Academician in the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 兩宮西幸，貽穀聞警，步行追及宣化，流涕入對，隨扈西安。

translations.literal: When the two palaces went west, Yi Gu heard the alarm, went on foot and caught up at Xuanhua, entered audience in tears, and followed in escort to Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: When the court fled west in 1900, Yi Gu heard the alarm, walked on foot until he caught up at Xuanhua, presented himself to the throne in tears, and accompanied the entourage to Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 授兵部左侍郎，屢召詢時政，直言無隱，上皆嘉納。

translations.literal: He was appointed Left Vice President of the Board of War, repeatedly summoned to be questioned on current policy, spoke frankly without concealment, and the throne approved all.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Left Vice President of the Board of War, was repeatedly summoned to discuss current affairs, spoke frankly without reserve, and the throne approved his counsel.

sentences.zh: 明年，扈駕還京。

translations.literal: The next year he escorted the carriage back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he accompanied the court on its return to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 兵部公署已毀，假柏林寺為廨舍。

translations.literal: The Board of War's public offices had been destroyed; he borrowed Bailin Temple as his bureau quarters.
translations.idiomatic: The Board of War's offices had been destroyed, so he made do with Bailin Temple as his headquarters.

sentences.zh: 貽穀昕夕蒞事，如在行在時。

translations.literal: Yi Gu attended to business morning and evening as when at the traveling court.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Gu attended to affairs from dawn to dusk just as he had at the traveling court.

sentences.zh: 是冬，山西巡撫岑春煊奏晉邊察哈爾左右翼及西北烏蘭察布、伊克昭兩盟荒地甚多，請及時開墾，派大員督辦。

translations.literal: That winter, Shanxi Governor Cen Chunxuan memorialized that on the Shanxi border the Left and Right Wings of Chahar and the northwestern Ulanqab and Ike Zhao Leagues had much wasteland and requested timely opening to reclamation with a high official dispatched to supervise.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Shanxi Governor Cen Chunxuan memorialized that the Chahar Left and Right Wings on the Shanxi frontier and the Ulanqab and Ike Zhao Leagues in the northwest held extensive wasteland, urged that it be opened promptly to cultivation, and requested that a senior official be dispatched to supervise the work.

sentences.zh: 詔以貽穀為督辦蒙旗墾務大臣。

translations.literal: An edict appointed Yi Gu Grand Minister in charge of Mongol-banner reclamation.
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed Yi Gu Grand Minister for the Supervision of Mongol-banner Reclamation.

sentences.zh: 貽穀有經濟才，艱貞自勵。

translations.literal: Yi Gu had talent for statecraft and strove amid hardship with steadfast integrity.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Gu had talent for practical statecraft and cultivated steadfast integrity amid hardship.

sentences.zh: 既奉命，銳以籌邊殖民為己任。

translations.literal: Once he received the command, he keenly took frontier planning and colonization as his own duty.
translations.idiomatic: Once commissioned, he took frontier development and colonization as his personal mission with fierce dedication.

sentences.zh: 其督墾地界，綿延直、晉、秦、隴、長城、河套，凡數千里。

translations.literal: The reclamation zones he supervised stretched continuously across Zhili, Shanxi, Shaanxi, Gansu, the Great Wall, and the Hetao region, altogether several thousand li.
translations.idiomatic: The lands under his supervision stretched thousands of li across Zhili, Shanxi, Shaanxi, Gansu, the Great Wall line, and the Hetao bend of the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 統籌全局，擬陳開墾大綱，規畫至詳。

translations.literal: He coordinated the overall situation, drafted a grand outline for opening reclamation, and planned in the utmost detail.
translations.idiomatic: He coordinated the entire undertaking, drafted a comprehensive program for opening the land, and planned every detail with care.

sentences.zh: 疏入報可，並加理籓部尚書銜，節制秦、晉、隴沿邊各廳州縣。

translations.literal: His memorial entered and was approved, and he was additionally given the rank of Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs with control over all circuit, prefecture, and county offices along the Shaanxi, Shanxi, and Gansu frontiers.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was approved, and he was further given ministerial rank in the Court of Colonial Affairs with authority over all frontier subprefectures, prefectures, and counties in Shaanxi, Shanxi, and Gansu.

sentences.zh: 旋复授綏遠城將軍，事權始一。

translations.literal: Soon he was again appointed General of Suiyuancheng; authority was unified at last.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed General of Suiyuancheng as well, and his authority was finally unified under one command.

sentences.zh: 貽穀首重官墾。

translations.literal: Yi Gu placed official-led reclamation first.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Gu gave highest priority to government-led reclamation.

sentences.zh: 立墾務局，設東路公司，官商合辦。

translations.literal: He established a reclamation bureau, set up an Eastern Route Company, and ran it jointly by official and merchant enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: He established a reclamation bureau and an Eastern Route Company, organized as a joint official–merchant venture.

sentences.zh: 初辦察哈爾右翼，改舊設押荒局為豐寧墾務局，旋分為豐鎮、寧遠兩局。

translations.literal: He first handled the Chahar Right Wing, converting the old wasteland-pawn bureau into the Fengning Reclamation Bureau, soon divided into Fengzhen and Ningyuan bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: He began with the Chahar Right Wing, converting the existing wasteland-pledge bureau into the Fengning Reclamation Bureau, which was soon split into separate bureaus at Fengzhen and Ningyuan.

sentences.zh: 清查舊墾，招闢生荒，派員丈勘繪圖，酌留蒙員隨缺地畝及公共牧廠，其餘乃悉開放之。

translations.literal: He investigated old reclamation, recruited opening of virgin wasteland, dispatched officers to measure and map, allowed retention of Mongol-banner allotments for banner members, land attached to vacancies, and common pasture farms—the rest was fully opened.
translations.idiomatic: He surveyed existing reclamation, recruited settlers for virgin land, dispatched officers to measure and chart the terrain, set aside allotments for banner Mongols, vacancy-linked plots, and communal pastures—and opened everything else to settlement.

sentences.zh: 牛羊群地，錯處左右翼間，直隸、山西民戶，頻年互爭，貽穀親往勘之，由固爾班諾爾中分界址，其爭始息。

translations.literal: Cattle and sheep herd lands lay intermixed between the two wings; Zhili and Shanxi civilian households quarreled year after year; Yi Gu went in person to survey, drew boundary marks through Gurban Nor, and the dispute then ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Pasturelands for cattle and sheep herds lay scattered between the two wings, and civilian settlers from Zhili and Shanxi had quarreled over them for years; Yi Gu surveyed in person and drew the boundary through Lake Gurban Nor, and the disputes finally subsided.

sentences.zh: 繼放察哈爾左翼地，為留牧廠、隨缺，與右翼同。

translations.literal: He next opened Chahar Left Wing land, retaining pasture farms and vacancy allotments as with the Right Wing.
translations.idiomatic: He next opened the Chahar Left Wing, reserving pasture farms and vacancy allotments on the same terms as the Right Wing.

sentences.zh: 移正黃旗牛羊兩群於商都牧群，又移騸馬群於騍馬群，籌撥直、晉邊廳學田。

translations.literal: He moved the Plain Yellow Banner's cattle and sheep herds to the Shangdu pasture herd, also moved the gelding herd to the riding-horse herd, and arranged allocation of school lands from Zhili and Shanxi border subprefectures.
translations.idiomatic: He relocated the Plain Yellow Banner's cattle and sheep herds to the Shangdu pastures, transferred the gelding herd to the riding-horse pastures, and arranged allocations of school lands from border subprefectures in Zhili and Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 烏蘭察布、伊克昭兩盟夾河套為部落，烏拉特三公，杭錦、達拉特數旗，尤逼近套。

translations.literal: The Ulanqab and Ike Zhao Leagues, flanking the Hetao as tribal lands, included the three princes of Urat, the Hanggin and Dalad banners, especially close to the bend.
translations.idiomatic: The Ulanqab and Ike Zhao Leagues flanked the Hetao loop as tribal territories; the three Urat princedoms and the Hanggin and Dalad banners lay especially close to the bend.

sentences.zh: 其地恃河渠灌之，自元、明以還，渠盡湮廢，或併古道不存。

translations.literal: Those lands relied on irrigation canals; since Yuan and Ming, canals were entirely silted up and abandoned, or old routes no longer existed.
translations.idiomatic: These lands depended on irrigation, but since the Yuan and Ming dynasties the canals had silted up and fallen into ruin, and in some places even the old courses had vanished.

sentences.zh: 貽穀躬蒞其地相度，修通長濟、永濟兩大幹渠，又疏濬塔布河、五加河、老郭諸渠，增鑿枝渠數十、子渠三百餘道，水利始興。

translations.literal: Yi Gu went in person to the locality to survey, restored and opened the Changji and Yongji main trunk canals, also dredged the Tabu, Wujia, and Laoguo canals, and opened dozens of branch canals and more than three hundred lateral ditches; waterworks then flourished.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Gu surveyed the region in person, restored the Changji and Yongji main trunk canals, dredged the Tabu, Wujia, and Laoguo channels, and opened dozens of branch canals and more than three hundred subsidiary ditches—at last waterworks flourished again.

sentences.zh: 先後六年，始自察哈爾兩翼八旗，而推之二盟十三旗，以及土默特、綏遠右衛與駐防馬廠各地，凡墾放逾十萬頃，東西二千餘裡。

translations.literal: Over six years, beginning with the Chahar two-wing eight banners and extending to the two leagues' thirteen banners, as well as Tumed, Suiyuan Right Guard, and garrison horse-farm areas everywhere, reclamation opened exceeded one hundred thousand qing, two thousand-odd li east to west.
translations.idiomatic: Over six years, beginning with the eight banners of the Chahar Left and Right Wings and extending to the thirteen banners of the two leagues, as well as Tumed, Suiyuan Right Guard, and garrison pasturelands, he opened more than one hundred thousand qing of land across more than two thousand li from east to west.

sentences.zh: 絕塞大漠，蔚成村落，眾皆稱之。

translations.literal: Desolate frontier desert blossomed into villages; all praised him.
translations.idiomatic: Barren frontier desert blossomed into villages, and people everywhere praised his achievement.

sentences.zh: 復以時創設陸軍，置槍砲器械，築營壘，興警察，立武備陸軍學校及中小蒙學校數十所，創工藝局、婦女工廠。

translations.literal: He also in due course created an army, installed firearms and artillery, built stockades, developed police, established a Military Preparation Army School and dozens of primary and secondary Mongol schools, and founded crafts bureaus and women's workshops.
translations.idiomatic: He also raised a modern army in due course, procured firearms and artillery, built stockades, established a police force, founded a military academy and dozens of primary and secondary schools for Mongols, and set up craft workshops and women's factories.

sentences.zh: 資送綏遠學生出洋，或就北洋學堂肄業。

translations.literal: He financed Suiyuan students to study abroad or to attend the Beiyang academies.
translations.idiomatic: He sponsored students from Suiyuan to study abroad or enroll in the Beiyang academies.

sentences.zh: 建設興和、陶林、武川、五原、東勝五廳。

translations.literal: He established the five subprefectures of Xinghe, Taolin, Wuchuan, Wuyuan, and Dongsheng.
translations.idiomatic: He established five new subprefectures: Xinghe, Taolin, Wuchuan, Wuyuan, and Dongsheng.

sentences.zh: 練巡防馬步十營，修繕綏遠城垣，濬城外溝渠，建築蒙地村屯，植樹造林，勸課園圃果實蔬菜。

translations.literal: He drilled ten battalions of mounted and foot patrol guards, repaired Suiyuancheng's walls, dredged the moat and canals outside the walls, built Mongol-country villages and colonies, planted trees and forests, and urged cultivation of gardens, fruit, and vegetables.
translations.idiomatic: He trained ten battalions of mounted and foot patrol troops, repaired the walls of Suiyuancheng, dredged the moats and canals outside the city, built settlements across Mongol lands, promoted afforestation, and encouraged kitchen gardens for fruit and vegetables.

sentences.zh: 暇輒就田間耕夫婦豎問疾苦，或策單騎馳營壘，召士卒申儆之，教之以習勤崇儉，戒嗜好，勤勤如訓子弟，不率者乃罰譴之。

translations.literal: In leisure he would go among field laborers, farmers' wives, and servants to inquire of their hardships, or ride alone to the camps, summon soldiers to admonish them, teach diligence and frugality, warn against indulgence, instructing as earnestly as training sons and younger brothers—those who would not comply he then punished and reprimanded.
translations.idiomatic: In moments of leisure he would visit peasants and farm laborers in the fields to ask after their hardships, or ride alone to the camps to admonish the troops—urging diligence and frugality, warning against indulgence, instructing them as earnestly as he would his own sons; only those who would not heed him faced punishment.

sentences.zh: 方其治河套墾地，蒙人時起抗阻，台吉丹丕爾攘其旗主地，戕文武官吏，貽穀請於朝誅之，眾始帖伏。

translations.literal: While he was governing Hetao reclamation lands, Mongols often rose in resistance; Taiji Danpiber seized his banner prince's land and killed civil and military officials; Yi Gu memorialized the court to execute him, and the multitude then submitted.
translations.idiomatic: While he was developing the Hetao, Mongols often resisted; Taiji Danpiber seized princely banner lands and killed civil and military officials; Yi Gu memorialized for his execution, and only then did the people submit.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，貽穀劾歸化城副都統文哲琿侵吞庫款，而文哲琿先以敗壞邊局、蒙民怨恨劾貽穀。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year Yi Gu impeached Deputy Military Governor Wenzhehun of Guihuacheng for embezzling treasury funds, while Wenzhehun had already impeached Yi Gu for ruining the frontier situation and incurring Mongol resentment.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fourth year (1908) Yi Gu impeached Wenzhehun, Deputy Military Governor of Guihuacheng, for embezzling government funds—while Wenzhehun had already impeached Yi Gu for ruining frontier affairs and arousing Mongol resentment.

sentences.zh: 朝命軍機大臣鹿傳霖等往查，傳霖以已革布政使樊增祥等為隨員，奏覆，衹貽穀職，逮京，下法部勘問，三年不能決，卒坐誅丹丕爾事，譴戍川邊。

translations.literal: The court ordered Grand Councilor Lu Chuanlin and others to investigate; Lu Chuanlin took the dismissed provincial treasurer Fan Zengxiang and others as accompanying staff; their memorial replied; Yi Gu alone was stripped of office, escorted to the capital, and sent to the Ministry of Justice for examination; for three years no verdict could be reached; he was finally punished on account of the execution of Danpiber and banished to the Sichuan frontier.
translations.idiomatic: The court dispatched Grand Councilor Lu Chuanlin and others to investigate; Lu took the dismissed provincial treasurer Fan Zengxiang among his staff. Their report resulted in Yi Gu alone being stripped of office, brought to the capital, and remanded to the Ministry of Justice—inquiry dragged on for three years without resolution until he was finally punished for the execution of Danpiber and banished to the Sichuan frontier.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年赴戍，方經鄂，武昌變起，直隸總督陳夔龍奏請進止，詔改易州安置。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xuantong he went to his exile post; passing through Hubei, the Wuchang uprising arose; Zhili Governor-General Chen Kuilong memorialized asking guidance; an edict changed his placement to Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xuantong (1911) he set out for exile; while passing through Hubei the Wuchang uprising broke out; Zhili Governor-General Chen Kuilong memorialized for instructions, and an edict relocated him to Yizhou instead.

sentences.zh: 國變後，嘗自歎曰：「昔姜埰譴戍宣城衛，自號'宣城老兵'。

translations.literal: After the dynastic change, he once sighed and said: "Formerly Jiang Cai was banished to guard Xuancheng, and styled himself 'the old soldier of Xuancheng.'
translations.idiomatic: After the fall of the dynasty he once sighed and said, "Long ago Jiang Cai was banished to Xuancheng Guard and styled himself 'the Old Soldier of Xuancheng.'

sentences.zh: 吾其終此矣！

translations.literal: Surely I shall end likewise!
translations.idiomatic: Surely I shall end the same way!

sentences.zh: 即死，必葬於是。

translations.literal: Even in death I shall be buried there.
translations.idiomatic: When I die, I shall be buried there.

sentences.zh: 」丙寅年，卒。

translations.literal: " In the Bingyin year he died.
translations.idiomatic: " In the Bingyin year (1926) he died.

sentences.zh: 晉邊官紳念其德，請昭雪，釋處分，遂葬易州白楊村，成其志。

translations.literal: Shanxi frontier officials and gentry remembering his virtue requested rehabilitation, release from punishment, and he was buried at Baiyang Village, Yizhou, fulfilling his wish.
translations.idiomatic: Officials and gentry of the Shanxi frontier, remembering his service, petitioned for his rehabilitation and the lifting of his penalties; he was buried at Baiyang Village in Yizhou, fulfilling his wish.

sentences.zh: 信勤，字懷民，鈕祜祿氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人。

translations.literal: Xin Qin, style Huaimin, of the Niuhuru clan, a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Xin Qin, courtesy name Huaimin, of the Niuhuru clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 以廕生累至浙江布政使，署巡撫，代貽穀為綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: By yinsheng privilege he rose successively to Zhejiang Provincial Treasurer, acted as governor, and replaced Yi Gu as General of Suiyuancheng.
translations.idiomatic: Through hereditary privilege he rose to Zhejiang Provincial Treasurer, served as acting governor, and succeeded Yi Gu as General of Suiyuancheng.

sentences.zh: 督辦墾務，踵其遺規。

translations.literal: He supervised reclamation affairs, following his predecessor's legacy regulations.
translations.idiomatic: He supervised reclamation affairs, following his predecessor's established program.

sentences.zh: 益勤遠略，頗禮致賢才，思有所建樹，功未竟而遽罷。

translations.literal: He was all the more diligent in distant strategy, rather courted worthy talent, and hoped to achieve something, but his work was not finished when he was suddenly dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: He pursued frontier strategy with still greater diligence, cultivated talented men, and hoped to build on his predecessor's achievements—but his work was cut short before it was finished.

sentences.zh: 辛亥後，久病，卒。

translations.literal: After Xinhai he was long ill and died.
translations.idiomatic: After the Xinhai Revolution he suffered prolonged illness and died.

sentences.zh: 論曰：將軍、都統，職視專圻，西北邊疆大臣與之並重。

translations.literal: The critique states: Generals and lieutenant-generals hold posts comparable to sole charge of a region; great ministers of the northwest frontier are equally weighty.
translations.idiomatic: Commentary: The posts of general and lieutenant-general rank with sole charge of a territorial command; great frontier ministers of the northwest carry equal weight.

sentences.zh: 非才足當一面者不能任也。

translations.literal: None but talent sufficient to hold a front alone can bear such responsibility.
translations.idiomatic: Only men whose talent was equal to holding a frontier on their own could fill such posts.

sentences.zh: 榮全、升泰以下諸人，或多戰績，或著邊功，或勤旗務，或兼民治，所至皆能盡其職，多有可稱，故並著於篇。

translations.literal: Rong Quan, Sheng Tai, and the others below—some with many battle achievements, some famed for frontier merit, some diligent in banner affairs, some combining civil governance—wherever they went all could fulfill their duties; many are praiseworthy; hence they are all set forth in this chapter.
translations.idiomatic: From Rong Quan and Sheng Tai downward, some won distinction in battle, others in frontier service, others in banner administration, and still others in civil governance as well; wherever they served they fulfilled their duties admirably, and there is much to commend—hence they are all recorded in this chapter.
